title.zh: 卷3 本紀三 太宗本紀二
title.raw: 卷3 本紀三 太宗本紀二

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，以希福為內弘文院大學士，范文程、鮑承先俱為內秘書院大學士，剛林為內國史院大學士。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu day: Hife was made Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy; Fan Wencheng and Bao Chengxian were both made Grand Secretaries of the Inner Secretariat Academy; Ganglin was made Grand Secretary of the Inner Historiography Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu day, Hife was appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Hongwen Academy; Fan Wencheng and Bao Chengxian were both appointed Grand Secretaries of the Inner Secretariat Academy; and Ganglin was appointed Grand Secretary of the Inner Historiography Academy.

sentences.zh: 壬子，貝勒薩哈廉卒，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: Renzi day: beile Sahaliyan died; court audiences were suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Sahaliyan died, and the court mourned for three days without holding audience.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，始薦櫻桃於太廟。

translations.literal: Guichou day: cherries were first offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day cherries were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，設都察院，諭曰：「朕或奢侈無度，誤誅功臣；

translations.literal: Dingsi day: the Censorate was established. An edict said: “I may grow extravagant beyond measure and wrongly execute meritorious ministers;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Censorate was established. An edict declared: “I may grow wasteful beyond all measure and put loyal servants of the state to death by mistake;

sentences.zh: 或畋獵逸樂，不理政事；

translations.literal: or hunt and take my ease, not attending to government;
translations.idiomatic: or I may hunt and take my pleasure, leaving government untended;

sentences.zh: 或棄忠任奸，黜陟未當；

translations.literal: or cast aside the loyal and employ the treacherous, with promotions and dismissals unfitting;
translations.idiomatic: or I may cast aside the faithful and raise the treacherous, promoting and demoting without justice;

sentences.zh: 爾其直陳無隱。

translations.literal: then you must speak straight to me without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: then you must speak to me plainly, hiding nothing.

sentences.zh: 諸貝勒或廢職業，黷貨偷安，爾其指參。

translations.literal: If any beile neglects his duties, amasses goods by corruption, and seeks only ease, you are to impeach him directly.
translations.idiomatic: If any prince neglects his charge, takes bribes, and seeks only comfort, you are to impeach him to his face.

sentences.zh: 六部或斷事偏謬，審讞淹遲，爾其察奏。

translations.literal: If any of the Six Ministries judges cases with bias and error, or delays trial and sentencing, you are to investigate and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: If any of the Six Ministries decides cases with prejudice or lets trials drag on, you are to examine the matter and report.

sentences.zh: 明國陋習，此衙門亦賄賂之府也，宜相防檢。

translations.literal: Under Ming vulgar custom this office too became a house of bribery; guard against it and inspect one another.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming this very office became a den of graft; you must watch one another and guard against it.

sentences.zh: 挾讐劾人，例當加罪。

translations.literal: Whoever impeaches another out of private hatred shall, by precedent, receive an added penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever brings impeachment out of private spite shall, by established rule, suffer an added punishment.

sentences.zh: 餘所言是，即行；

translations.literal: Of the rest, whatever you say that is correct shall be carried out at once;
translations.idiomatic: As for whatever else you say that is right, it shall be done at once;

sentences.zh: 所言非，不問。

translations.literal: whatever is incorrect shall not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: what is wrong shall not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，追封薩哈廉為和碩穎親王。

translations.literal: ” Renxu day: Sahaliyan was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Su of the First Rank, Prince Ying.
translations.idiomatic: ” On renxu day Sahaliyan was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Su of the First Rank, posthumously called Prince Ying.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以張存仁為都察院承政，祖澤洪為吏部承政，韓大勛為戶部承政，姜新為禮部承政，祖澤潤為兵部承政，李云為刑部承政，裴國珍為工部承政。

translations.literal: Jisi day: Zhang Cunren was made Chancellor of the Censorate; Zu Zehong Chancellor of the Board of Personnel; Han Daxun Chancellor of the Board of Revenue; Jiang Xin Chancellor of the Board of Rites; Zu Zerun Chancellor of the Board of War; Li Yun Chancellor of the Board of Punishments; Pei Guozhen Chancellor of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhang Cunren was named Chancellor of the Censorate; Zu Zehong of the Board of Personnel; Han Daxun of the Board of Revenue; Jiang Xin of the Board of Rites; Zu Zerun of the Board of War; Li Yun of the Board of Punishments; and Pei Guozhen of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 都統伊爾登罷。

translations.literal: Border-prince banner commander Yilideng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The border-prince banner commander Yilideng was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 以圖爾格為鑲白旗都統。

translations.literal: Turgai was made commander of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Turgai was appointed commander of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，武英郡王阿濟格、饒餘貝勒阿巴泰、公揚古利等率師征明。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: Prince Wu of the first rank Ajige, Prince Raoyu Abatai, the duke Yangguli, and others led armies on campaign against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Prince Wu Ajige, Prince Raoyu Abatai, the duke Yangguli, and others took the field against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 上御翔鳳閣面授方略，且誡諭之。

translations.literal: The Emperor went in person to the Xiangfeng Pavilion to impart strategy and also to admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji went in person to the Xiangfeng Pavilion to set out the plan of campaign and to charge them with his warnings.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，師行。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: the armies marched.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the armies set out.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌朔，授蒙古降人布爾噶都等世職有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu first day: hereditary stipends of varying rank were granted to surrendered Mongols including Burgut and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, the jiaxu cyclical day, hereditary offices of differing rank were granted to the surrendered Mongols Burgut and others.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命豫親王多鐸管禮部事，肅親王豪格管戶部事。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Prince Yu Dodo was ordered to oversee the Board of Rites; Prince Su Hooge the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Yu Dodo was put in charge of the Board of Rites and Prince Su Hooge of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封薩哈廉子阿達禮為多羅郡王。

translations.literal: Jiashen day: Sahaliyan's son Adahai was enfeoffed as Prince of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Sahaliyan's son Adahai was enfeoffed as a prince of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以國舅阿什達爾漢為都察院承政，尼堪為蒙古承政。

translations.literal: Bingxu day: the imperial maternal uncle Ashdahan was made Chancellor of the Censorate; Nikan Chancellor for Mongol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the imperial maternal uncle Ashdahan was made Chancellor of the Censorate, and Nikan Chancellor for Mongol affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，檄外籓蒙古兵征明。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiwei day: an order was sent to levy troops from the outer Mongol domains for war against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, orders went out to the outer Mongol domains to levy troops for the campaign against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，阿濟格等會師出延慶州，俘人畜一萬五千有奇。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: Ajige and the others united their forces and marched out through Yanqing Prefecture, capturing men and livestock in excess of fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Ajige and the others joined forces, marched out through Yanqing, and took more than fifteen thousand people and animals.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，遣官祭孔子。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingchou day: officials were dispatched to sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, officers were sent to offer sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，成親王岳託、肅親王豪格以罪降多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: Xinsi day: Prince Cheng Yoto and Prince Su Hooge, on account of crimes, were demoted from princes of the first rank to princes of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Prince Cheng Yoto and Prince Su Hooge were reduced, for offenses, from princes of the first rank to princes of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，睿親王多爾袞，豫親王多鐸，貝勒岳託、豪格舉師征明。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: Prince Rui Dorgon, Prince Yu Dodo, and the princes Yoto and Hooge raised armies and marched against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince Rui Dorgon, Prince Yu Dodo, and the princes Yoto and Hooge took the field against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，明兵入鹻場，命吳善、季思哈率兵御之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wushen day: Ming troops entered the saltern district; Wu Shan and Jisihā were ordered to lead troops to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen day, Ming forces entered the saltern country; Wu Shan and Jisihā were ordered out to meet them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，阿濟格等奏我軍經保定至安州，克十二城，五十六戰皆捷，生擒總兵巢丕昌等人畜十八萬。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: Ajige and the others reported that our army had passed through Baoding to Anzhou, taken twelve cities, won fifty-six engagements, and captured alive Regional Commander Chao Buchang together with people and livestock numbering one hundred eighty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Ajige and the others reported that the army had marched from Baoding to Anzhou, taken twelve cities, fought fifty-six actions without defeat, and captured alive the regional commander Chao Buchang along with people and livestock totaling one hundred eighty thousand.

sentences.zh: 庚申，伊勒慎等追明兵至娘娘宮渡口，見敵船甚眾，不敢進，奏聞。

translations.literal: Gengshen day: Ilšan and others pursued Ming troops to the Niangniang Palace ford; the enemy ships were very numerous and they did not dare advance, and reported this.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Ilšan and others pursued Ming troops to the Niangniang Palace crossing; the enemy fleet was so large they dared not press on and sent word back.

sentences.zh: 命宜蓀往援，復遣杜度率師助之。

translations.literal: Yisun was ordered to go to their aid; Dudu was again dispatched with an army to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Yisun was ordered to their relief, and Dudu was sent again with a column to reinforce them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蒙古達賴、拜賀、拜音代等自塔山來降。

translations.literal: Xinyou day: the Mongols Dalai, Baiho, and Baiyundai and others surrendered from Tashan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Mongols Dalai, Baiho, Baiyundai, and others came in submission from Tashan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，阿濟格等師還。

translations.literal: Jisi day: the armies of Ajige and the others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the armies under Ajige and the others returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，多爾袞等師還。

translations.literal: Tenth month, guiyou day: the armies of Dorgon and the others returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiyou day, the armies of Dorgon and the others came back.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣大學士希福等往察哈爾、喀爾喀、科爾沁諸部稽戶口，編佐領，讞庶獄，頒法律，禁奸盜。

translations.literal: Dinghai day: Grand Secretary Hife and others were sent to the Chahar, Khalkha, and Khorchin tribes to examine household registers, organize company captains, adjudicate ordinary cases, promulgate laws, and prohibit theft and brigandage.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Grand Secretary Hife and others were sent among the Chahar, Khalkha, and Khorchin to check household registers, arrange company captains, hear ordinary cases, promulgate the laws, and forbid theft and robbery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，朝鮮國王李倧以書來，卻之。

translations.literal: Wuxu day: King Li Jong of Korea sent a letter; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day King Li Jong of Korea sent a letter; the court refused it.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，覆命岳託管兵部事，豪格管戶部事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wushen day: Yoto was restored to oversee the Board of War; Hooge the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wushen day, Yoto was again put in charge of the Board of War and Hooge of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 己酉，衛寨桑等自蒙古喀爾喀部還，偕其使衛徵喇嘛等來貢。

translations.literal: Jiyou day: Weizhaisan and others returned from the Khalkha Mongols, and together with the envoy Wei Zheng Lama and others came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Weizhaisan and others returned from the Khalkha, and with the envoy Wei Zheng Lama and others came to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，徵兵外籓。

translations.literal: Xinhai day: troops were levied from the outer domains.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day troops were levied from the outer domains.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，諭曰：「朕讀史，知金世宗真賢君也。

translations.literal: Guichou day: an edict said: “When I read history, I know that Emperor Shizong of the Jin was a truly worthy ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict ran: “In reading history I see that Emperor Shizong of the Jin was a ruler of true worth.

sentences.zh: 當熙宗及完顏亮時，盡廢太祖、太宗舊制，盤樂無度。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Xizong and Wanyan Liang they abolished all the old institutions of Taizu and Taizong and gave themselves over to pleasure without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xizong and Wanyan Liang the old ways of Taizu and Taizong were cast off altogether, and pleasure knew no bounds.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，恐子孫效法漢人，諭以無忘祖法，練習騎射。

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne, fearing that his descendants might follow the Han Chinese, he admonished them not to forget the ancestral ways and to practice riding and archery.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong came to the throne he feared his descendants would take after the Han; he charged them never to forget the ancestral customs and to keep practicing horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 後世一不遵守，以訖於亡。

translations.literal: Later generations failed to observe this a single time, until the state perished.
translations.idiomatic: Later generations did not keep to it even once, and the dynasty was lost.

sentences.zh: 我國嫻騎射，以戰則克，以攻則取。

translations.literal: Our state is skilled in riding and shooting; in battle we prevail, in attack we take.
translations.idiomatic: Our people are practiced in horse and bow; in battle we overcome, in assault we seize.

sentences.zh: 往者巴克什達海等屢勸朕易滿洲衣服以從漢制。

translations.literal: Formerly Dahai the šakši repeatedly urged me to change Manchu dress to follow Han custom.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Dahai the learned adviser urged me again and again to change Manchu dress and follow Han usage.

sentences.zh: 朕惟寬衣博鮹，必廢騎射，當朕之身，豈有變更。

translations.literal: I consider that with loose robes and wide sleeves one must abandon riding and archery; in my own lifetime, how could there be such a change?
translations.idiomatic: I hold that with flowing robes and broad sleeves one cannot keep to the saddle and the bow; while I live, how could such a change be made?

sentences.zh: 恐後世子孫忘之，廢騎射而效漢人，滋足慮焉。

translations.literal: Yet I fear that later descendants will forget this, abandon riding and archery to imitate the Han, and that is truly cause for worry.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I fear that those who come after will forget, lay aside horse and bow to copy the Han, and that is what truly troubles me.

sentences.zh: 爾等謹識之。

translations.literal: You must bear this carefully in mind.
translations.idiomatic: You must keep this firmly in mind.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，太祖實錄成。

translations.literal: ” Yimao day: the Veritable Record of Taizu was completed.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yimao day the Veritable Record of Taizu was completed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑冬至，大祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Yichou day, winter solstice: Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice of the yichou cyclical day Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 以將征朝鮮告祭天地、太廟。

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth and the Imperial Ancestral Temple were notified by sacrifice that an expedition against Korea was imminent.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth and the Imperial Ancestral Temple were told by sacrifice that an expedition against Korea was at hand.

sentences.zh: 己巳，頒軍令，傳檄朝鮮。

translations.literal: Jisi day: military ordinances were promulgated and a proclamation was sent to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the army regulations were issued and a manifesto was sent to Korea.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未朔，外籓蒙古諸王貝勒率兵會於盛京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinwei first day: the princes and beiles of the outer Mongol domains gathered with their armies at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, the xinwei cyclical day, the princes and beiles of the outer Mongols assembled with their troops at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王濟爾哈朗留守，武英郡王阿濟格駐牛庄備邊，饒餘貝勒阿巴泰駐噶海城收集邊民防敵。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng Jirhalang remained on garrison duty; Prince Wu Ajige camped at Niuzhuang to guard the frontier; Prince Raoyu Abatai camped at Gaihaicheng to collect border populations and guard against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng Jirhalang stayed behind on guard; Prince Wu Ajige encamped at Niuzhuang to secure the border; Prince Raoyu Abatai encamped at Gaihaicheng to gather border people and watch for the enemy.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上率禮親王代善等征朝鮮，大軍次沙河堡，睿親王多爾袞、貝勒豪格分兵自寬甸入長山口。

translations.literal: Renshen day: the Emperor led Prince Dai Daishan and others on an expedition against Korea. The main army halted at Shahe Fort; Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Hooge led separate columns in through Kuandian by way of Changshan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Huang Taiji led Prince Dai Daishan and others against Korea. The main host halted at Shahe Fort; Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Hooge took separate routes in through Kuandian by Changshan Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣馬福塔等率兵三百為商賈裝，潛往圍朝鮮國都，多鐸及貝子碩讬、尼堪以兵千人繼之，郡王滿硃習禮、布塔齊引兵來會。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: Mafuta and others with three hundred men disguised as merchants secretly went to surround the Korean capital; Dodo and the imperial sons Šoto and Nikan followed with a thousand men; the princes Manjusil and Butaci led troops to join them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Mafuta and others, three hundred men dressed as merchants, stole forward to invest the Korean capital; Dodo and the imperial sons Šoto and Nikan followed with a thousand men; and the princes Manjusil and Butaci brought their columns to the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 己卯，貝勒岳託、公揚古利以兵三千助多鐸軍。

translations.literal: Jimao day: Prince Yoto and the duke Yangguli with three thousand men reinforced Dodo's army.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Yoto and the duke Yangguli with three thousand men reinforced Dodo's force.

sentences.zh: 上率大軍距鎮江三十里為營，令安平貝勒杜度、恭順王孔有德等護輜重居後。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the main army and encamped thirty li from Zhenjiang, ordering Prince Anping Dudu, the Prince Who Sincerely Obeyed Kong Youde, and others to guard the baggage train in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji led the main army and made camp thirty li from Zhenjiang, leaving Prince Anping Dudu, the Prince Who Sincerely Obeyed Kong Youde, and others to protect the baggage in the rear.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，渡鎮江至義州。

translations.literal: Gengchen day: they crossed the Yalu at Zhenjiang and reached Uiju.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the host crossed the Yalu at Zhenjiang and reached Uiju.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上至郭山城。

translations.literal: Renwu day: the Emperor reached Kwaksan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Huang Taiji reached Kwaksan.

sentences.zh: 其定州游擊來援，度不敵，自刎死。

translations.literal: Its Chongju patrol commander came to relieve it; seeing he could not match them, he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: The Chongju patrol commander came to its relief; seeing he could not prevail, he took his own life.

sentences.zh: 郭山降。

translations.literal: Kwaksan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Kwaksan submitted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至定州。

translations.literal: Guiwei day: they reached Chongju.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the army reached Chongju.

sentences.zh: 定州亦降。

translations.literal: Chongju also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Chongju submitted as well.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，至安州，以書諭朝鮮守臣勸降。

translations.literal: Yiyou day: they reached Anju and sent a letter instructing the Korean defenders to advise surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day they reached Anju and sent a letter urging the Korean defenders to surrender.

sentences.zh: 己丑，多鐸等進圍朝鮮國都。

translations.literal: Jichou day: Dodo and the others advanced and besieged the Korean capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Dodo and the others pressed on and laid siege to the Korean capital.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李倧遁南漢山城。

translations.literal: King Li Jong of Korea fled to Namhansanseong.
translations.idiomatic: King Li Jong of Korea fled to Namhansanseong.

sentences.zh: 多鐸等復圍之，並敗其諸道援兵。

translations.literal: Dodo and the others besieged it again and defeated relief armies from every route.
translations.idiomatic: Dodo and the others invested it anew and broke the relief columns from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，瓦爾喀葉辰、麻福塔居朝鮮，聞大軍至，以其眾來歸。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: the Jurchen Yečen and Mafuta who had settled in Korea, hearing the great army had arrived, brought their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Jurchen Yečen and Mafuta, who had been living in Korea, heard that the great army had come and brought their people in submission.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上至臨津江，會天暖冰泮，不可渡，忽驟雨，冰結，大軍畢渡。

translations.literal: Dingyou day: the Emperor reached the Imjin River. The weather had warmed and the ice had melted, making crossing impossible; then rain fell suddenly, the ice froze again, and the whole army crossed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Huang Taiji reached the Imjin. The weather had turned mild and the ice had broken up so that no crossing was possible; then rain fell in a torrent, the ice set hard again, and the whole army went over.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命都統譚泰等搜剿朝鮮國都，留蒙古兵與俱。

translations.literal: Jihai day: Commander Tan Tai and others were ordered to search and mop up in the Korean capital; Mongol troops were left with them.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Commander Tan Tai and others were ordered to scour the Korean capital, and Mongol troops were left with them.

sentences.zh: 上以大軍合圍南漢城。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the main army in a combined siege of Namhansanseong.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji led the main host in a general siege of Namhansanseong.

sentences.zh: 是歲，土默特部古祿格楚虎爾，鄂爾多斯部額林臣濟農、台吉土巴等俱來朝。

translations.literal: That year, Gürcüktu of the Tümed, Erdeni Jinong and Taiji Toba of the Ordos, and others all came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gürcüktu of the Tümed, Erdeni Jinong and Taiji Toba of the Ordos, and others all came to court.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬寅，朝鮮全羅道總兵來援，岳託擊走之。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, renyin day: the commander of Jeolla Province, Korea, came to relieve the city; Yoto struck and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, the first month, on renyin day the commander of Korea's Jeolla circuit came to relieve the fortress; Yoto attacked and put him to flight.

sentences.zh: 遣英俄爾岱、馬福塔齎敕諭朝鮮閣臣，數其前後敗盟之罪。

translations.literal: Ying'erdai and Mafuta were sent bearing imperial instructions to remonstrate with the Korean court ministers, recounting their repeated breaches of alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Ying'erdai and Mafuta were sent with an imperial message to the Korean ministers, setting out their repeated betrayals of treaty.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大軍渡漢江，營於江滸。

translations.literal: Jiachen day: the main army crossed the Han River and encamped on the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the main army crossed the Han and encamped on the shore.

sentences.zh: 丁未，朝鮮全羅、忠清二道合兵來援，多鐸、揚古利擊走之。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: the armies of Jeolla and Chungcheong provinces combined to relieve the city; Dodo and Yangguli struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the armies of Jeolla and Chungcheong joined to relieve the fortress; Dodo and Yangguli attacked and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 揚古利被創卒。

translations.literal: Yangguli was wounded and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yangguli was wounded and died of his wounds.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，多爾袞、豪格軍克長山，連戰皆捷，以兵來會，杜度等運砲車亦至。

translations.literal: Gengxu day: the armies of Dorgon and Hooge took Changshan; winning every battle they came to join the main force, and Dudu and others with the artillery train also arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the columns of Dorgon and Hooge took Changshan; fighting every action to success they came to join the main host, and Dudu with the artillery train arrived as well.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮勢益蹙，李倧以書數乞和。

translations.literal: Korea's situation grew ever tighter; Li Jong sent repeated letters begging peace.
translations.idiomatic: Korea's plight grew desperate; Li Jong sent letter after letter begging for peace.

sentences.zh: 上許其出降。

translations.literal: The Emperor permitted him to come out and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji allowed him to come out and submit.

sentences.zh: 倧上書稱臣，逡巡不敢出。

translations.literal: Li Jong wrote declaring himself a subject, but hesitated and did not dare come forth.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jong wrote acknowledging himself a subject, yet hung back and did not dare appear.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，多爾袞軍入江華島，得倧妻子，護至軍前。

translations.literal: Renxu day: Dorgon's army entered Ganghwa Island, took Yi Jong's wife and children, and escorted them before the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Dorgon's force entered Ganghwa Island, seized Li Jong's wife and children, and brought them before the army.

sentences.zh: 復諭倧曰：「來則室家可完，社稷可保，朕不食言，否則不能久待。

translations.literal: He again instructed Yi Jong: “If you come, your household may be preserved and the altars of the state secured; I do not eat my words. Otherwise I cannot wait long.”
translations.idiomatic: He again told Li Jong: “If you come, your house may be made whole and the altars of state preserved; I do not break my word. If not, I cannot wait long.”

sentences.zh: 」倧聞江華島陷，妻子被俘，南漢城旦夕且下，乃請降。

translations.literal: Hearing Ganghwa Island had fallen and his wife and children were captives, with Namhansanseong about to fall at any moment, he then asked to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that Ganghwa had fallen and his wife and children were prisoners, and that Namhansanseong would fall at any hour, he then asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朝鮮國王李倧率其子𣳫及群臣朝服出降於漢江東岸三田渡，獻明所給敕印。

translations.literal: Gengwu day: King Li Jong of Korea, leading his son 𣳫 and the full body of ministers in court dress, came out to surrender on the east bank of the Han at Samdo Ferry, presenting the patent and seal given by the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day King Li Jong of Korea, with his son 𣳫 and the ministers in full court dress, came out to surrender on the east bank of the Han at Samdo Ferry and presented the patent and seal the Ming had granted him.

sentences.zh: 上慰諭賜坐，還其妻子及群臣家屬，仍厚賜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor comforted him with edicts, granted him a seat, returned his wife, children, and the families of his ministers, and gave generous gifts besides.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji received him with comforting words, gave him a seat, restored his wife and children and the families of his ministers, and lavished gifts besides.

sentences.zh: 命英俄爾岱、馬福塔送倧返其國都，留其子𣳫、淏為質。

translations.literal: Ying'erdai and Mafuta were ordered to escort Yi Jong back to his capital; his sons 𣳫 and Hao were kept as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Ying'erdai and Mafuta were ordered to conduct Li Jong back to his capital; his sons 𣳫 and Hao were kept as hostages.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，班師。

translations.literal: Second month, renshen day: the armies withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen day, the armies withdrew.

sentences.zh: 貝子碩託、恭順王孔有德等率朝鮮舟師取明皮島。

translations.literal: The imperial son Šoto, Kong Youde, and others led Korean naval forces to take Ming Pi Island.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son Šoto, Kong Youde, and others led Korean naval forces against the Ming-held P'i Island.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李倧表請減貢額。

translations.literal: King Li Jong of Korea memorialized requesting a reduction in the tribute quota.
translations.idiomatic: King Li Jong of Korea memorialized asking that the tribute levy be reduced.

sentences.zh: 詔免丁丑、戊寅兩年貢物，自乙卯秋季始，仍貢如額。

translations.literal: An edict exempted the tribute levies for the dingchou and wuyin years; from the autumn of the yimao cyclical term tribute would again be paid in full.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted the tribute of the dingchou and wuyin years; from the autumn of the yimao cycle tribute would again be paid in full.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，諭多爾袞等禁掠降民，違者該管官同罪。

translations.literal: Jiaxu day: an edict to Dorgon and the others forbade looting surrendered people; violators and the officials in charge would share the same punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict to Dorgon and the others forbade plundering surrendered people; offender and supervising officer would share the same penalty.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上還盛京。

translations.literal: Xinmao day: the Emperor returned to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Huang Taiji returned to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭戶部平糶勸農。

translations.literal: Guisi day: the Board of Revenue was instructed to release grain from storage and urge farming.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Board of Revenue was ordered to sell grain from the public granaries at fair price and to encourage agriculture.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，殺朝鮮臺諫官洪翼漢、校理尹集、修撰吳達濟，以敗盟故。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen day: the remonstrating officials Hong I-han, Yun Jip, and Wu Daegye of Korea were executed for breaking the alliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen day, the Korean remonstrating officials Hong I-han, Yun Jip, and Wu Daegye were put to death for breaking the alliance.

sentences.zh: 丁未，武英郡王阿濟格率師助攻皮島。

translations.literal: Dingwei day: Prince Wu Ajige led an army to join the assault on Pi Island.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince Wu Ajige led a force to join the attack on P'i Island.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷蓋州城工。

translations.literal: Wuwu day: work on the Gaizhou fortifications was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day work on the walls of Gaizhou was stopped.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，睿親王多爾袞以朝鮮質子李𣳫、李淏及朝鮮諸大臣子至盛京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jimao, Prince Rui Dorgon brought the Korean hostages Li Ho, Li Hao, and the sons of Korean grand ministers to Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao, Prince Rui Dorgon escorted the Korean hostages Li Ho and Li Hao, together with the sons of leading Korean ministers, to the capital at Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，阿濟格師克皮島，斬明總兵沈世魁、金日觀。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Prince Ying Ajige's army captured Pidao and beheaded the Ming regional commanders Shen Shikui and Jin Riguan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Ajige's forces took Pidao and executed the Ming generals Shen Shikui and Jin Riguan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，安平貝勒杜度率大軍後隊還。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Prince Anping Duodu led the army's rear column back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Prince Anping Duodu returned at the head of the army's rear guard.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命固山貝子尼堪、羅託、博洛等預議國政。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, he ordered the gushan beizi Nikan, Luotuo, Boluo, and others to deliberate on state affairs in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the throne ordered the banner princes Nikan, Luotuo, Boluo, and others to join in advance deliberation on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 增置每旗議政大臣三人，集群臣諭之曰：「向者議政大臣額少，或出師奉使，而朕左右無人，卑微之臣，又不可使參國議。

translations.literal: He added three Deliberative Ministers per banner, gathered the ministers, and instructed them, saying: "Formerly the number of Deliberative Ministers was small; when some went on campaign or embassy missions, I had no one at my side, yet humble officials could not be allowed to join in national deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Three Deliberative Ministers were added for each banner. Summoning the court, the Emperor said: "In the past there were too few Deliberative Ministers. When they marched or went on embassy, I was left without counsel at my side, yet men of low rank could not be admitted to national deliberation.

sentences.zh: 今特擇爾等置之議政之列，當以民生休戚為念，慎毋怠惰，有負朝廷。

translations.literal: Now I have specially chosen you and placed you in the ranks of deliberation; you must keep the people's weal and woe in mind, be careful not to be idle, and not fail the court."
translations.idiomatic: "I have now chosen you expressly for deliberation. Let the people's welfare be your concern; do not grow slack or fail the dynasty."

sentences.zh: 前蒙古察哈爾林丹悖謬不道，其臣不諫，以至失國。

translations.literal: Formerly in Mongolia, Chakhar's Lindan was perverse and without the Way; his ministers did not remonstrate, so that he lost the state.
translations.idiomatic: "Of old, Lindan of the Chakhar Mongols was lawless and his ministers would not remonstrate with him, and the realm was lost.

sentences.zh: 朕有過失，爾諸臣即當面諍。

translations.literal: If I have faults, you ministers must remonstrate to my face.
translations.idiomatic: If I err, you must speak frankly to my face.

sentences.zh: 使面從而退有後言，委過於上，非純臣也。

translations.literal: To agree to my face yet withdraw and speak afterward, casting blame upward, is not the conduct of a pure minister."
translations.idiomatic: To assent in my presence and murmur afterward, shifting blame to me, is not the conduct of a loyal minister."

sentences.zh: 」又諭曰：「昔金熙宗循漢俗，服漢衣冠，盡忘本國言語，太祖、太宗之業遂衰。

translations.literal: He further instructed, saying: "In former times Emperor Xizong of Jin followed Han customs, wore Han robes and caps, and wholly forgot the language of his own country; the enterprise of Taizu and Taizong thus declined.
translations.idiomatic: He spoke again: "Jin's Emperor Xizong once adopted Han ways, dressed in Han robes, and forgot his own tongue, and the achievements of Taizu and Taizong withered.

sentences.zh: 夫弓矢我之長技，今不親騎射，惟耽宴樂，則武備浸弛。

translations.literal: Bow and arrow are our long skill; if now we do not personally ride and shoot but only indulge in feasting and pleasure, then martial readiness will gradually slacken.
translations.idiomatic: The bow is our strength. If we cease to ride and shoot and give ourselves only to feasting, our arms will grow soft.

sentences.zh: 朕每出獵，冀不忘騎射，勤練士卒。

translations.literal: Whenever I go out hunting, it is in hope of not forgetting riding and shooting and of diligently training the troops.
translations.idiomatic: I hunt so that I may not forget the saddle and may keep the soldiers in hard training.

sentences.zh: 諸王貝勒務轉相告誡，使後世無變祖宗之制。

translations.literal: Princes and beile must earnestly pass this admonition one to another, so that later generations do not alter the institutions of our ancestors."
translations.idiomatic: Let every prince and beile repeat this warning to the next, so that our descendants do not change the ways of the founders."

sentences.zh: 閏四月癸卯，蒙古貢異獸，名齊赫特。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month, on the day guimao, the Mongols presented a strange beast named Qihete.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on guimao, the Mongols presented a rare animal called Qihete.

sentences.zh: 壬子，武英郡王阿濟格師還。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Prince Ying Ajige's army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Ajige's army came back.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，朝鮮國王李倧遣使奉表謝恩贖俘獲。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengwu, the King of Korea Li Zong sent envoys with a memorial thanking for grace and ransoming captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu, King Li Zong of Korea sent envoys with a memorial of thanks and to redeem prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣朝鮮從征皮島總兵林慶業歸國，以敕獎朝鮮王。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, he sent back the Korean commander Lin Qingye, who had joined the campaign against Pidao, to his country, and rewarded the Korean king with an imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Lin Qingye, the Korean general who had served at Pidao, was sent home, and an edict of commendation was sent to the Korean king.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，章京尼堪等征瓦爾喀，降之，師行逕朝鮮咸鏡道，凡兩月始達，至是還。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the zhangjing Nikan and others campaigned against the Warka, subdued them, marched straight through Korea's Hamgyeong circuit, and only after two months reached their goal; now they returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Nikan and other commanders, having subdued the Warka after a march of two months through Korea's Hamgyeong region, returned.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，授喀喇沁歸附人阿玉石等官。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinchou, offices were granted to the submitted Khalkha men Ayushi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou, Ayushi and other Khalkha who had submitted were given official posts.

sentences.zh: 明千總王國亮、都司胡應登、百總李忠國等自海島來降。

translations.literal: The Ming platoon commander Wang Guoliang, regional commander Hu Yingdeng, company commander Li Zhongguo, and others came over from the coastal islands.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming officers Wang Guoliang, Hu Yingdeng, Li Zhongguo, and others surrendered from the coastal islands.

sentences.zh: 莽古爾泰子光袞獲罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Manggūltai's son Guanggun was found guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guanggun, son of Manggūltai, was convicted and put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，諭曰：「頃朝鮮之役，兵行無紀，見利即前，竟忘國憲。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he instructed, saying: "In the recent Korean campaign, the army marched without discipline, advancing whenever there was profit and utterly forgetting the laws of the state.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Emperor said: "In the Korean war the troops marched without discipline, rushing after booty and forgetting the laws of the state.

sentences.zh: 自今宜思所以宣布法紀修明典制者。

translations.literal: From now on you should consider how to proclaim the laws and regulations and refine the institutions."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter you must consider how to enforce discipline and perfect our institutions."

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，以臣朝鮮，克皮島，祭告太廟、福陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, because Korea had submitted and Pidao had been taken, he offered sacrifice and reported to the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Fuling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, with Korea subdued and Pidao taken, he reported the victory to the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Fuling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，朝鮮國王李倧請平值贖俘，不許。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the King of Korea Li Zong asked to ransom captives at a flat rate; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, King Li Zong asked to redeem captives at a fixed price; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 甲子，論諸將征朝鮮及皮島違律罪。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the generals were judged for offenses against the regulations in the Korean and Pidao campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the generals were tried for breaches of discipline in the Korean and Pidao campaigns.

sentences.zh: 禮親王代善論革爵，宥之。

translations.literal: Prince Li Daishan was judged to have his rank reduced; he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Li Daishan was sentenced to reduction of rank but was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王濟爾哈朗以下論罰有差。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng Jirhala and those below were sentenced to penalties of varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng Jirhala and the others below him were punished in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，遣喀凱等分道征瓦爾喀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, Kākai and others were sent on separate routes to campaign against the Warka.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, Kākai and others were dispatched on separate routes against the Warka.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，戶部參政恩克有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Household Ministry councillor Enke was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Enke, councillor of the Household Ministry, was convicted and executed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，誡諭漢官以空言欺飾者。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Han officials were admonished against deceiving and embellishing with empty words.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Han officials were warned against empty flattery and false reports.

sentences.zh: 智順王尚可喜自皮島師還。

translations.literal: Prince Zhishun Shang Kexi returned from the Pidao campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhishun Shang Kexi returned from the Pidao expedition.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 癸未，優恤朝鮮、皮島陣亡將士揚古利等，贈官襲職有差。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, favorable care was extended to the officers and soldiers who died at Korea and Pidao, such as Yangguli; posthumous offices and hereditary posts were granted in varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the dead of Korea and Pidao, including Yangguli, were honored with posthumous ranks and hereditary appointments according to merit.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，明都司高繼功等自石城島來降。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Ming regional commander Gao Jigong and others came over from Shicheng Island.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Ming commander Gao Jigong and others surrendered from Shicheng Island.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，追封皇后父科爾沁貝勒莽古思為和碩福親王。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the empress's father, the Khorchin beile Manggusi, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Fu of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Manggusi, Khorchin beile and father of the empress, was posthumously created Prince Fu of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以朝鮮及皮島之捷宣諭祖大壽。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the victories at Korea and Pidao were announced to Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the victories in Korea and at Pidao were proclaimed to Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，分漢軍為兩旗，以總兵官石廷柱、馬光遠為都統，分理左右翼。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Han Army was divided into two banners; the regional commanders Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan were made commanders-in-chief to administer the left and right wings respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Han Army was split into two banners, with Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan as commanders-in-chief of the left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔，再恤攻皮島、朝鮮陣亡將士洪文魁等，贈官襲職有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month bingshen, further care was extended to the officers and soldiers who died in the attacks on Pidao and Korea, such as Hong Wenkui; posthumous offices and hereditary posts were granted in varying degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, bingshen, further honors were granted to the dead of Pidao and Korea, including Hong Wenkui, with posthumous ranks and hereditary posts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，貝勒岳託以罪降貝子，罰金，解兵部任。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Prince Yuetuo was reduced to beizi for an offense, fined, and relieved of his post in the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yuetuo was demoted to beizi, fined, and removed from the Board of War for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命睿親王多爾袞、饒餘貝勒阿巴泰築都爾鼻城。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Raoyu Abatai were ordered to build Durben city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Dorgon and Abatai were ordered to build Durben.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣阿什達爾漢等往蒙古巴林、札魯特、喀喇沁、土默特、阿魯諸部會理刑獄。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Ashadahan and others were sent to the Mongol divisions of Barin, Jarud, Khalkha, Tümed, and Aru to jointly try criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Ashadahan and others were sent to the Barin, Jarud, Khalkha, Tümed, and Aru Mongols to hold joint trials.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，出獵撫安堡，以書招明石城島守將沈志祥。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinwei, he went hunting at Fu'an Fort and sent a letter summoning the Ming defender of Shicheng Island, Shen Zhixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, the Emperor hunted at Fu'an Fort and wrote to summon the Ming commander of Shicheng Island, Shen Zhixiang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，兵部參政穆爾泰以罪褫職。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the War Ministry councillor Murtai was dismissed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Murtai, councillor of the War Ministry, was dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 貝勒豪格以逼勒蒙古台吉博洛罪，罰金，罷管部務。

translations.literal: Prince Hooge was fined and removed from departmental duties for the offense of coercing the Mongol taiji Boluo.
translations.idiomatic: Hooge was fined and stripped of his ministry for coercing the Mongol taiji Boluo.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未朔，初頒滿洲、蒙古、漢字歷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day of the month yiwei, calendars in Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese were first issued.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month, yiwei, calendars in Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese were issued for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丙午，厄魯特顧實車臣綽爾濟遣使來貢，厄魯特道遠，以元年遣使，是年冬始至。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Gushichan Tseren Chöljin of the Oirats sent tribute envoys; the Oirat road was distant, and envoys dispatched in the first year of the reign only arrived that winter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Gushichan Tseren Chöljin of the Oirats sent tribute; the road was so long that envoys sent in the first year of the reign only reached court that winter.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣英俄爾岱、馬福塔、達雲齎敕冊封李倧為朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Ingolidai, Mafuta, and Dayun were sent bearing an edict to invest Li Zong as King of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Ingolidai, Mafuta, and Dayun were sent with an edict investing Li Zong as King of Korea.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengwu, heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengwu, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李倧遣使來貢，復表請歸其世子，並陳國中災變困窮狀。

translations.literal: The King of Korea Li Zong sent envoys with tribute and again memorialized asking for the return of his heir, also describing disasters and destitution in the country.
translations.idiomatic: King Li Zong sent tribute envoys and again asked that his heir be returned, describing famine and calamity at home.

sentences.zh: 上不許，敕諭賜賚之。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not consent and issued an edict of instruction and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused and replied with an edict of instruction and gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，烏硃穆秦濟農聞上善養民，率貝勒等舉國來附。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the jinong of Ujumcin, hearing that the Emperor cared well for the people, led the beile and others of the whole nation to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Ujumcin jinong, hearing of the Emperor's care for the people, led his beile and the whole tribe to submit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，追封揚古利為武勛王。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Yangguli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Martial Merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yangguli was posthumously created Prince of Martial Merit.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，出獵打草灘。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, he went hunting at Dacaotan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Emperor hunted at Dacaotan.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，葉克書、星訥率師征卦爾察。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiachen, Yekešu and Sine led troops to campaign against the Gūrca.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen, Yekešu and Sine marched against the Gūrca.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，征瓦爾喀諸將奏捷。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the generals campaigning against the Warka reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Warka commanders reported victory.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蒿齊忒部貝勒博羅特、托尼洛率屬來歸。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the beile Borot and Toniluo of the Qošot led their dependents to come over.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Borot and Toniluo, beile of the Qošot, led their people in submission.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格遣丹岱等敗明兵於清河。

translations.literal: Ajige sent Dandai and others to defeat Ming troops at Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige sent Dandai and others to defeat Ming forces at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 是歲，虎爾哈部托科羅氏、克益克勒氏、耨野勒氏，黑龍江索倫部博穆博果爾，黑龍江巴爾達齊，精格里河扈育布祿俱來朝。

translations.literal: That year, the Tokoro, Keyikle, and Noyol clans of the Hurha, Bomobogor of the Solon on the Amur, Baldaci of the Amur, and Huyubulu of the Jinggili River all came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Tokoro, Keyikle, and Noyol Hurha, the Solon Bomobogor, Baldaci of the Amur, and Huyubulu of the Jinggili all came to pay homage.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛未，命貝子岳託仍為多羅貝勒，管領旗務。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the first month day xinwei, Prince Yuetuo was again made a prince of the first rank and put in charge of banner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on xinwei in the first month, Yuetuo was restored to prince of the first rank and given charge of his banner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以德穆圖為戶部承政。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Demutu was made councillor of the Household Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Demutu was appointed councillor of the Household Ministry.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇第九子生，是為世祖章皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the ninth imperial son was born; this was Emperor Shizu, the Zhang Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the ninth son was born—the future Emperor Shizu.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，親征喀爾喀，豫親王多鐸、武英郡王阿濟格從，禮親王代善、鄭親王濟爾哈朗、睿親王多爾袞、安平貝勒杜度居守。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingyou, he personally campaigned against the Khalkha; Prince Yu Dodo and Prince Ying Ajige followed; Princes Li Daishan, Zheng Jirhala, Rui Dorgon, and Anping Duodu remained to guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, the Emperor marched in person against the Khalkha, with Dodo and Ajige; Daishan, Jirhala, Dorgon, and Duodu stayed behind to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次喀爾占，外籓諸王貝勒等以師來會。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he halted at Kharzhan; the princes and beile of the outer dependencies came with their armies to join.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he encamped at Kharzhan, where the tributary princes and beile joined him with their troops.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀聞之，遁去。

translations.literal: The Khalkha, hearing of this, fled away.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha, hearing of the advance, fled.

sentences.zh: 上行獵達爾那洛湖西，駐蹕。

translations.literal: The Emperor went hunting west of Dalnal Lake and halted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted west of Dalnal Lake and made camp.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次奎屯布喇克。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he halted at Kuitunbulak.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he encamped at Kuitunbulak.

sentences.zh: 庚申，明東江總兵沈志祥率石城島將佐軍民來降。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Ming Dongjiang commander Shen Zhixiang led the officers, soldiers, and people of Shicheng Island to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Ming commander Shen Zhixiang brought the garrison and people of Shicheng Island in surrender.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣勞薩以書告明宣府守臣趣互市，且以歲幣歸我。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Laosai was sent with a letter informing the Ming defender of Xuanfu to hasten mutual trade and to return the annual payments to us.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Laosai was sent to urge the Ming garrison at Xuanfu to resume trade and restore the yearly payments.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子朔，次博碩堆，命留守諸王築遼陽城。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day jiazi, he halted at Boshuodui and ordered the princes who remained on guard to build Liaoyang city.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, jiazi, he halted at Boshuodui and ordered the regents to build Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次義奚里。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he halted at Yixili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he encamped at Yixili.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，至登努蘇特而還。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, he reached Dengnusute and turned back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, he reached Dengnusute and turned back.

sentences.zh: 壬午，次上都河源，河西平地湧泉高五尺。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he halted at the headwaters of Shangdu; on the flat ground west of the river a spring gushed five feet high.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, he halted at the headwaters of Shangdu, where a spring burst five feet high from the flat ground west of the river.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午朔，次布克圖裡，葉克書等征黑龍江告捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day jiawu, he halted at Buketuri; Yekešu and others reported victory in the Heilongjiang campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month, jiawu, he halted at Buketuri as Yekešu reported victory on the Amur.

sentences.zh: 乙未，至遼河。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, he reached the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he reached the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，次杜棱城，明山海關太監高起潛遣人詭議和。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, he halted at Duleng city; the Shanhaiguan eunuch Gao Qiqian sent men falsely to discuss peace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he halted at Duleng; the eunuch Gao Qiqian of Shanhaiguan sent men under false pretenses to talk of peace.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次札哈納里忒。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, he halted at Zhahanarite.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, he encamped at Zhahanarite.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次察木哈。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, he halted at Chamuha.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he encamped at Chamuha.

sentences.zh: 庚子，次俄岳博洛。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, he halted at Oyobolo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, he encamped at Oyobolo.

sentences.zh: 都爾鼻城工竣，改名屏城。

translations.literal: The work on Durben city was completed and its name changed to Ping city.
translations.idiomatic: Durben was finished and renamed Ping.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，杜爾伯特部卦爾察札馬柰等來朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Zhamanai of the Dorbet Gūrca and others came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zhamanai of the Dorbet Gūrca and others came to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，至遼陽，閱新城。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, he reached Liaoyang and inspected the new city.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, he reached Liaoyang and inspected the new walls.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上還盛京。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Emperor returned to Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Emperor returned to Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 葉克書、星訥征黑龍江師還。

translations.literal: The armies of Yekešu and Sine campaigning on the Heilongjiang returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yekešu and Sine returned from the Amur campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命明降將沈志祥以其眾志成城居撫順。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Ming surrendered general Shen Zhixiang was ordered to settle his followers at Fushun and strengthen the walls.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the defector Shen Zhixiang was ordered to settle his men at Fushun and fortify the place.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尼噶里等征虎爾哈師還。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the army of Nigali campaigning against the Hurha returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Nigali's Hurha expedition returned.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，修盛京至遼河道路，以睿親王多爾袞、饒餘貝勒阿巴泰董其役。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guiyou, the road from Shengjing to the Liao River was repaired, with Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Raoyu Abatai supervising the work.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, the road from Shengjing to the Liao was repaired under Dorgon and Abatai.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，禮親王代善屬下人覺善有罪，鄭親王濟爾哈朗等請誅之，議削代善爵。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Jueshan, a subordinate of Prince Li Daishan, was guilty; Prince Zheng Jirhala and others asked that he be executed and proposed reducing Daishan's rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jueshan, a man of Daishan's household, was found guilty; Jirhala and others asked for his death and for Daishan's rank to be reduced.

sentences.zh: 以細故不許，並貸覺善。

translations.literal: Because it was a trifling matter, this was not permitted, and Jueshan was also pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was deemed trivial; the request was denied and Jueshan was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，始設理籓院，專治蒙古諸部事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, the Court of Colonial Affairs was first established, exclusively to administer the affairs of the Mongol divisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the Court of Colonial Affairs was established to govern the Mongol tribes.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌朔，諭諸王大臣曰：「自古建國，皆立制度，辨等威。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day renxu, he instructed the princes and grand ministers, saying: "Since ancient times, in founding a state, institutions have been established and ranks and majesty distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, renxu, the Emperor told the princes and ministers: "Every founding state sets laws and fixes ranks.

sentences.zh: 今親王、郡王、貝勒、貝子、公主、額駙名號等級，均有定制，乃皆不遵行，違棄成憲，誠何心耶？

translations.literal: Now the titles and grades of princes of the first rank, princes of the second rank, beile, beizi, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law all have fixed regulations, yet none are observed and the established statutes are cast aside—what is in your hearts?"
translations.idiomatic: The ranks of prince, beile, beizi, princess, and imperial son-in-law are all fixed by law, yet you ignore them and cast aside the statutes—what do you mean by it?"

sentences.zh: 昔金太祖、太宗兄弟一心，克成大統。

translations.literal: Formerly the Jin Taizu and Taizong, brothers of one mind, were able to accomplish the great inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: "Jin's Taizu and Taizong, united as brothers, won the empire.

sentences.zh: 朕當創業之時，爾等顧不能同心體國恪守典常乎？

translations.literal: When I was founding the enterprise, could you not likewise be of one heart, embody the state, and keep to the constant laws?"
translations.idiomatic: When I was building the realm, could you not have been of one heart and kept the laws?"

sentences.zh: 」諸王皆引罪。

translations.literal: All the princes acknowledged their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The princes all confessed fault.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，喀爾喀使臣達爾漢囊蘇喇嘛歸，諭之曰：「朕以兵討不庭，以德撫有眾。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Khalkha envoy Darhan Nangsu Lama returned; he was instructed, saying: "I use arms to punish the rebellious and virtue to comfort the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Khalkha envoy Darhan Nangsu Lama was dismissed with this message: "I punish rebellion with arms and win men with virtue.

sentences.zh: 天以蒙古諸部與朕，爾喀爾喀乃興兵犯歸化，甚非分也。

translations.literal: Heaven has given the Mongol divisions to me; yet you Khalkha raised troops and attacked Guisui—this is greatly out of bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven gave me the Mongols; yet you Khalkha took arms against Guisui—far beyond your place.

sentences.zh: 爾不獲已，有逃竄偷生耳。

translations.literal: You had no choice but to flee and steal your lives.
translations.idiomatic: You could only flee and cling to life.

sentences.zh: 爾所能至，我軍豈不能至？

translations.literal: Where you can reach, can my army not also reach?
translations.idiomatic: Where you can go, my armies can go as well.

sentences.zh: 其速悔罪來歸，否則不爾宥也。

translations.literal: Repent at once and come back in submission, or you will not be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Repent quickly and return in submission, or you shall not be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，達雅齊等往明張家口議歲幣及互市。

translations.literal: On ren-shen, Dayaqi and others went to Zhangjiakou in Ming territory to negotiate the annual tribute payment and border markets.
translations.idiomatic: On the ren-shen day, Dayaqi and others went to the Ming post at Zhangjiakou to negotiate the annual tribute and mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，諭禮部曰：「凡有不遵定制變亂法紀者，王、貝勒、貝子議罰，官系三日，民枷責乃釋之。

translations.literal: On ding-chou, an edict to the Board of Rites said: "Whenever anyone fails to observe the prescribed regulations and disturbs law and order, princes, beile, and beise shall deliberate on punishment; officials shall be detained three days, and commoners shackled and flogged before release.
translations.idiomatic: On the ding-chou day, the Emperor instructed the Board of Rites: "Whoever disregards established regulations and upsets the legal order shall be punished after deliberation by princes, beile, and beise; officials are to be held three days, commoners put in the cangue and beaten before release.

sentences.zh: 出入坐起違式，及官階名號已定而仍稱舊名者，戒飭之。

translations.literal: Those who violate protocol in going out and in, sitting and rising, and those whose official ranks and titles have been fixed yet who still use old names, shall be admonished.
translations.idiomatic: Violations of court etiquette in movement, seating, and rising, and the continued use of obsolete titles after ranks have been fixed, shall be met with formal admonition.

sentences.zh: 有效他國衣冠、束髮裹足者，治重罪。

translations.literal: Those who adopt foreign dress, bind the hair, and bind the feet in foreign fashion shall be punished with severe penalties.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who wears foreign dress, binds the hair, or binds the feet in foreign fashion shall be punished severely.

sentences.zh: 」又諭大學士希福等曰：「朕不尚虛文，惟務實政。

translations.literal: He further instructed Grand Secretaries Xifu and others: "I do not value empty rhetoric but devote myself to practical governance.
translations.idiomatic: He further told Grand Secretaries Xifu and others: "I do not esteem empty forms but pursue real administration.

sentences.zh: 今國家殷富，政在養民。

translations.literal: The state is now prosperous; governance lies in nourishing the people.
translations.idiomatic: The realm is now wealthy; the heart of government is to nourish the people.

sentences.zh: 凡新舊人內窮困無妻孥馬匹者，或勇敢可充伍、以貧不能披甲者，許各陳訴，驗實給與。

translations.literal: Any among new and old subjects who are destitute within, lacking wives, children, or horses, or who are brave enough for military service but too poor to take the field in armor, may each petition; upon verification they shall be provided for.
translations.idiomatic: New and old subjects alike who are destitute, without wives, children, or horses, or who are fit for service but too poor to arm themselves, may petition; verified cases shall receive relief.

sentences.zh: 」禁以陣獲良家子女鬻為樂戶者。

translations.literal: It was forbidden to sell daughters of respectable families taken in battle as entertainer households.
translations.idiomatic: Selling respectable families' daughters taken in battle into entertainer households was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，更定部院官制，專設滿洲承政，以阿拜為吏部承政，英俄爾岱為戶部承政，滿達爾漢為禮部承政，宜蓀為兵部承政，郎球為刑部承政，薩木什喀為工部承政，貝子博洛為理籓院承政，阿什達爾漢為都察院承政。

translations.literal: On bing-xu, the ministries and yuans were reorganized, with Manchu cheng-political heads appointed exclusively: Abai for the Board of Personnel, Enggüldai for Revenue, Mandahai for Rites, Yisun for War, Langqiu for Punishments, Samushka for Works, Beizi Boluo for the Lifanyuan, and Ashidahan for the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the bing-xu day the ministries and courts were reorganized with Manchu chiefs alone: Abai at Personnel, Enggüldai at Revenue, Mandahai at Rites, Yisun at War, Langqiu at Punishments, Samushka at Works, Prince Boluo at the Lifanyuan, and Ashidahan at the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 命布顏為議政大臣。

translations.literal: Buyan was appointed deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: Buyan was made a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，禮部承政祝世昌以罪褫職，謫戍邊外。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jia-wu day, Zhu Shichang, cheng-political head of the Board of Rites, was dismissed for crime and banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jia-wu, Zhu Shichang, chief of the Board of Rites, was stripped of office for crime and sent to serve on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙申，吳拜、沙爾虎達連擊敗明兵於紅山口、羅文峪，又敗其密雲兵，殲之。

translations.literal: On bing-shen, Wu Bai and Sharhuda in succession defeated Ming forces at Hongshankou and Luowenyu, then again routed the Miyun troops and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-shen, Wu Bai and Sharhuda defeated Ming forces in turn at Hongshankou and Luowenyu, then routed and destroyed the Miyun army.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，地震。

translations.literal: On ding-you, an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-you there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊申，授中式舉人羅碩等十名佐領品級，免四丁，一等至三等秀才授護軍校品級，免二丁，各賜朝衣綢布有差，未入部者免一丁。

translations.literal: On wu-shen, the ten successful metropolitan candidates including Luo Shuo were granted zuoling rank, with exemption of four corvée households; first- through third-grade xiucai were given guard-officer rank with exemption of two households; each received court robes, silk, and cloth in graded amounts, and those not yet entering office were exempted one household.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-shen, Luo Shuo and nine other successful candidates were given company-commander rank and exemption from four corvée households; first- to third-grade licentiates received guard-officer rank and exemption from two households; all were granted court dress, silk, and cloth by grade, and those not yet in office one household's exemption.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，阿魯阿霸垓部額齊格諾顏等、蒿齊忒部博洛特諾木齊等並來朝貢。

translations.literal: On geng-xu, Erkegunu of the Aru Abaghai, Borot Nomochi of the Khorchin, and others all came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-xu, Erkegunu of the Aru Abaghai, Borot Nomochi of the Khorchin, and others all presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以睿親王多爾袞為奉命大將軍，統左翼兵，貝勒豪格、阿巴泰副之，貝勒岳託為揚武大將軍，統右翼兵，貝勒杜度副之，分道伐明。

translations.literal: On gui-chou, Prince Dorgon was made Grand General by Imperial Order to command the left wing, with Beile Hooge and Abatai as deputies; Beile Yueto was made Grand General Who Displays Might to command the right wing, with Beile Dodo as deputy; they marched by separate routes against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-chou, Prince Dorgon was appointed Grand General by Imperial Order to lead the left wing, with Beile Hooge and Abatai as lieutenants; Beile Yueto was made Grand General Who Displays Might to lead the right wing, with Beile Dodo as lieutenant; the two columns invaded the Ming by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 諭之曰：「主帥為眾所瞻，自處以禮，而濟之以和，則蒙古、朝鮮、漢人之來附者，自心悅而誠服。

translations.literal: He instructed them: "The commander is what the multitude looks to; if he conducts himself with propriety and tempers it with harmony, then Mongols, Koreans, and Han who come to submit will be pleased in heart and sincerely obedient.
translations.idiomatic: He charged them: "A commander is the army's mirror; conduct yourself with ritual and ease it with concord, and Mongols, Koreans, and Han who submit will follow in good faith.

sentences.zh: 若計一己之功，而不恤國之名譽，非所望焉。

translations.literal: If one reckons only personal merit and does not care for the state's reputation, that is not what is hoped for."
translations.idiomatic: To count private gain and neglect the state's honor is not what I expect of you."

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，岳託、杜度師行。

translations.literal: On ding-si, the armies of Yueto and Dodo set out.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-si the armies of Yueto and Dodo took the field.

sentences.zh: 己未，以巴圖魯准塔為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On ji-wei, Batulu Zhunta was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-wei, Batulu Zhunta was made Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，多爾袞、豪格、阿巴泰師行。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gui-hai, the armies of Dorgon, Hooge, and Abatai set out.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gui-hai, the armies of Dorgon, Hooge, and Abatai marched.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上親向山海關以撓明師。

translations.literal: On ren-shen, the Emperor personally advanced toward Shanhaiguan to harass the Ming army.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-shen the Emperor personally moved on Shanhaiguan to threaten the Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 徵孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜兵。

translations.literal: The troops of Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Forces under Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were called up.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，定優免人丁例。

translations.literal: On ding-chou, regulations on corvée exemptions were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-chou statutes on corvée exemption were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸演武場，閱兵較射。

translations.literal: On ding-hai, he visited the drill ground, reviewed the troops, and held an archery contest.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-hai he went to the drill ground, inspected the troops, and held a shooting match.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，岳託師自牆子嶺入，遇明兵。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on ding-you, Yueto's army entered through Qiangziling and encountered Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, tenth month, ding-you: Yueto's column entered by Qiangziling and met Ming troops.

sentences.zh: 明總兵官吳國俊敗走。

translations.literal: Ming Commander-in-Chief Wu Guojun was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming commander-in-chief Wu Guojun was beaten and fled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，多爾袞軍入青山關。

translations.literal: On wu-xu, Dorgon's army entered Qingshanguan.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-xu Dorgon's army passed Qingshanguan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上統大軍發盛京。

translations.literal: On ji-hai, the Emperor led the main army out from Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-hai the Emperor led the main host out of Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次渾河，科爾沁、喀喇沁各率兵來會。

translations.literal: On jia-chen, he halted at the Hun River; the Khorchin and Kharachin each led troops to join.
translations.idiomatic: On jia-chen he camped on the Hun River, where Khorchin and Kharachin contingents joined him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣沙爾虎達等率師趣義州。

translations.literal: On bing-wu, Sharhuda and others were dispatched to lead troops toward Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-wu Sharhuda and others were sent with troops toward Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命濟爾哈朗、多鐸各率師分趣前屯衛、寧遠、錦州，上親向義州。

translations.literal: On ji-you, Jirhalang and Dodo were each ordered to lead armies toward Qiantunwei, Ningyuan, and Jinzhou respectively; the Emperor personally advanced on Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-you Jirhalang and Dodo were each to march on Qiantunwei, Ningyuan, and Jinzhou; the Emperor himself pressed on Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，索海率師圍大凌河兩岸十四屯堡。

translations.literal: On xin-hai, Suohai led troops to besiege fourteen fortified villages on both banks of the Daling River.
translations.idiomatic: On xin-hai Suohai invested fourteen stockaded hamlets on both sides of the Daling River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上次義州，遣孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜、石廷柱、馬光遠以砲克其五臺。

translations.literal: On ren-zi, the Emperor halted at Yizhou and sent Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Ma Guangyuan with cannon to capture five platforms.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-zi the Emperor camped at Yizhou and sent Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Ma Guangyuan with artillery to take five redoubts.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次錦州。

translations.literal: On yi-mao, he halted at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-mao he encamped at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，多鐸克桑噶爾寨堡，殺其守將。

translations.literal: On bing-chen, Dodo captured the Sangarsai fortress and killed its garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-chen Dodo took Sangarsai fort and killed its commander.

sentences.zh: 孔有德等攻石家堡、戚家堡，並克之。

translations.literal: Kong Youde and others attacked Shijia Fort and Qijia Fort and captured them both.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde and others stormed Shijia and Qijia forts and took both.

sentences.zh: 戊午，孔有德等攻錦州西臺，臺中砲藥自發，臺壞，克之。

translations.literal: On wu-wu, Kong Youde and others attacked the west platform of Jinzhou; the gunpowder inside ignited of itself, the platform was ruined, and it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-wu Kong Youde and others assaulted Jinzhou's west redoubt; powder inside detonated by itself, the work collapsed, and it fell.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，多鐸將與濟爾哈朗合師徑中後所，會祖大壽往援北京，乘夜襲我師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, first day ji-wei: as Dodo was about to join Jirhalang and march straight on Zhonghousuo, Zu Dashou, who had gone to aid Beijing, raided our army by night.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, ji-wei, first day: as Dodo was to unite with Jirhalang and strike Zhonghousuo, Zu Dashou, marching to relieve Beijing, night-attacked our forces.

sentences.zh: 庚申，多鐸、濟爾哈朗還至中後所。

translations.literal: On geng-shen, Dodo and Jirhalang returned to Zhonghousuo.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-shen Dodo and Jirhalang fell back to Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 大壽懼，不敢出。

translations.literal: Dashou was afraid and did not dare come out.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou, in fear, would not come out.

sentences.zh: 石廷柱、馬光遠攻李雲屯、柏士屯、郭家堡、開州、井家堡，俱克之。

translations.literal: Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan attacked Li Yuntun, Baishitun, Guojia Fort, Kaizhou, and Jingjia Fort—all were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan took Li Yuntun, Baishitun, Guojia fort, Kaizhou, and Jingjia fort.

sentences.zh: 孔有德招降大福堡，又攻大臺，克之。

translations.literal: Kong Youde induced Dafu Fort to surrender and again attacked the great platform and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde won the surrender of Dafu fort and also carried the great redoubt.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大軍入山海關。

translations.literal: On xin-you, the main army entered Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On xin-you the main army passed Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上次連山。

translations.literal: On ren-xu, the Emperor halted at Lianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-xu the Emperor camped at Lianshan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，攻五里河臺，明守備李計友等率眾降。

translations.literal: On gui-hai, Wulihe Platform was attacked; Ming garrison commander Li Jiyou and others led their forces in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-hai Wulihe redoubt was assaulted; the Ming defender Li Jiyou and others surrendered with their men.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上至中後所，遇祖大壽收兵入城。

translations.literal: On ding-mao, the Emperor reached Zhonghousuo and encountered Zu Dashou withdrawing his troops into the city.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-mao the Emperor came to Zhonghousuo as Zu Dashou drew his troops back within the walls.

sentences.zh: 使告之曰：「別將軍數載，甚思一見。

translations.literal: He sent word: "We have been apart for years, General; I greatly wish to meet.
translations.idiomatic: He sent to say: "General, we have not met for years, and I have long wished to see you.

sentences.zh: 至於去留，終不相強。

translations.literal: As for staying or leaving, in the end I will not force you."
translations.idiomatic: Whether you stay or go, I will not compel you in the end."

sentences.zh: 將軍與我角勝，為將之道應爾。

translations.literal: For a general to contend with me for victory—that is what the way of command requires.
translations.idiomatic: For generals to vie on the field is the way of war.

sentences.zh: 朕不以此介意，亦原將軍勿疑。

translations.literal: I do not bear this against you, and I also ask that the General not doubt."
translations.idiomatic: I hold no grudge for that, and I ask that you not doubt me."

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，再遣使諭大壽，皆不答。

translations.literal: On wu-chen, envoys were again sent to instruct Dashou; he gave no reply.
translations.idiomatic: On wu-chen messengers were sent again to persuade Dashou; he answered nothing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，濟爾哈朗克摸龍關及五里堡屯臺。

translations.literal: On ji-si, Jirhalang captured Molong Pass and the Wulibao garrison platform.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-si Jirhalang took Molong Pass and the Wulibao stockade-redoubt.

sentences.zh: 庚午，班師。

translations.literal: On geng-wu, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-wu the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，次圖爾根河，遣蒙古軍各歸其部。

translations.literal: On geng-chen, he halted at the Turgun River and dismissed the Mongol armies each to its own tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-chen he camped on the Turgun River and sent the Mongol columns home to their tribes.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上還京。

translations.literal: On bing-xu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-xu the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，地震。

translations.literal: On ding-hai, an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-hai there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，刑部承政郎球有罪解任，以都察院參政索海代之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wu-xu, Langqiu, cheng-political head of the Board of Punishments, was removed for crime; Suohai, associate administrator of the Censorate, replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wu-xu: Langqiu, chief of Punishments, was dismissed for crime and Suohai of the Censorate succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，土默特部古祿格，杜爾伯特部卦爾察札馬奈，席北部阿拜、阿閔，兀札喇部井瑙、馬考、札柰、桑吉察，鄂爾多斯部額林臣濟農，阿魯阿霸垓部額齊格諾顏，蒿齊忒部博洛特諾木齊，黑龍江博穆博果爾、瓦代噶凌阿均來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Guluqe of the Tumed, Jamadai Jaqaca of the Durbed, Abai and Amin of the Khori, Jingnao, Makao, Zhachai, and Sangjicha of the Ujala, Erdeni Jinong of the Ordos, Erkegunu of the Aru Abaghai, Borot Nomochi of the Khorchin, and Bombogor and Wadaigalĭa of the Heilongjiang—all came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Guluqe of the Tumed, Jamadai Jaqaca of the Durbed, Abai and Amin of the Khori, Jingnao, Makao, Zhachai, and Sangjicha of the Ujala, Erdeni Jinong of the Ordos, Erkegunu of the Aru Abaghai, Borot Nomochi of the Khorchin, and Bombogor and Wadaigalĭa of the Heilongjiang all presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙丑，貝子碩託以罪降輔國公。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on yi-chou, Beizi Shotok was demoted to Duke Who Supports the State for crime.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, yi-chou: Beizi Shotok was reduced to Duke Who Supports the State for an offense.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇第三女固倫公主下嫁科爾沁額駙祁他特。

translations.literal: On jia-xu, the third imperial daughter, Princess Gulun, was married to the Khorchin imperial son-in-law Citete.
translations.idiomatic: On jia-xu the third imperial daughter, Princess Gulun, was given in marriage to the Khorchin consort Citete.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封沈志祥為續順公。

translations.literal: On ji-mao, Shen Zhixiang was enfeoffed as Duke of Continued Submission.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-mao Shen Zhixiang was created Duke of Continued Submission.

sentences.zh: 蒙古喇克等自錦州來歸。

translations.literal: The Mongol Lak and others came over from Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Lak and others defected from Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，蘇尼特部台吉噶布褚等率部人來歸。

translations.literal: On ding-hai, Taiji Gabuqu of the Sunite and others led their tribesmen in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On ding-hai Gabuqu, taiji of the Sunite, and others brought their people in submission.

sentences.zh: 是月，明以洪承疇總督薊、遼。

translations.literal: That month the Ming appointed Hong Chengchou governor-general of Ji and Liao.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Ming made Hong Chengchou governor-general of Ji and Liao.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，命武英郡王阿濟格率師征明。

translations.literal: In the second month, on ding-you, Prince Ajige was ordered to lead an army against the Ming.
