translations.idiomatic: Second month, ding-you: Prince Ajige was ordered to campaign against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上親統大軍繼之。

translations.literal: On ren-yin, the Emperor personally commanded the main army and followed.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-yin the Emperor took the field in person at the head of the main army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次翁啟爾渾。

translations.literal: On bing-wu, he halted at Ongniorhun.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-wu he encamped at Ongniorhun.

sentences.zh: 阿濟格遣使奏捷。

translations.literal: Ajige sent messengers reporting victory.
translations.idiomatic: Ajige dispatched couriers with news of victory.

sentences.zh: 蒙古奈曼等部率十三旗兵來會。

translations.literal: The Naiman and other Mongol tribes led thirteen-banner troops to join.
translations.idiomatic: The Naiman and other Mongol tribes brought thirteen banners to the rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，營松山。

translations.literal: On geng-xu, he encamped at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On geng-xu he pitched camp at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜、石廷柱、馬光遠以砲擊城外諸臺，克之。

translations.literal: Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Ma Guangyuan bombarded the platforms outside the walls and took them.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Ma Guangyuan shelled the outworks and carried them.

sentences.zh: 遣塔布囊布顏率師防烏欣河口。

translations.literal: Tabunang Biyan was dispatched to lead troops to guard the Wuxin River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Tabunang Biyan was sent to hold the mouth of the Wuxin River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上登松山南岡，授諸將方略。

translations.literal: On ren-zi, the Emperor ascended the southern ridge of Songshan and personally imparted strategy to the generals.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-zi the Emperor climbed the south ridge of Songshan and set out the plan of battle to his commanders.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，列砲攻城，雉堞悉毀。

translations.literal: On gui-chou, cannon were lined up to bombard the city; the battlements were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-chou batteries were opened on the town and the parapets were beaten flat.

sentences.zh: 明副將金國鳳拒守不下。

translations.literal: Ming Vice-General Jin Guofeng held out and would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming vice-commander Jin Guofeng held the place and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 上命豎雲梯急攻之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered scaling ladders set up for a pressing assault.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered storming ladders raised for an immediate assault.

sentences.zh: 代善請俟明日，上從之。

translations.literal: Daišan asked to wait until the next day; the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: Daišan asked to defer until the morrow, and the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 明人復完城堞，我軍不得入。

translations.literal: The Ming repaired the ramparts; our army could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming rebuilt the walls overnight, and our troops could not get in.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命阿濟格、尼堪、羅托等師圍塔山、連山。

translations.literal: On yi-mao, Ajige, Nikan, Loto, and others were ordered to surround Tashan and Lianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-mao Ajige, Nikan, Loto, and others were told to invest Tashan and Lianshan.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午朔，明軍援杏山，我兵邀擊之，斬五十人。

translations.literal: In the third month, first day wu-wu: Ming troops came to relieve Xingshan; our troops intercepted them and beheaded fifty men.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wu-wu, first day: Ming relief for Xingshan was intercepted and fifty heads taken.

sentences.zh: 己未，穿地道攻松山城。

translations.literal: On ji-wei, sapping tunnels were dug to attack Songshan city.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-wei mines were run against Songshan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命納海等馳略杏山。

translations.literal: On yi-chou, Naha and others were ordered to ride swiftly to harass Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-chou Naha and others were sent to raid Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 石廷柱、馬光遠攻觀民山臺，降之。

translations.literal: Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan attacked Guanminshan Platform and induced its surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tingzhu and Ma Guangyuan took Guanminshan redoubt by capitulation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，多爾袞、杜度等疏報自北京至山西界，復至山東，攻濟南府破之，蹂躪數千里，明兵望風披靡，克府一州三縣五十七，總督宣大盧象昇戰死，擒德王硃由賸、郡王硃慈漻、奉國將軍硃慈黨、總督太監馮允升等，俘獲人口五十餘萬，他物稱是。

translations.literal: On bing-yin, Dorgon, Dodo, and others reported that from Beijing through the Shanxi border and back to Shandong they had attacked and taken Jinan prefecture, ravaging several thousand li; Ming troops fled at the sight of them; they captured one prefecture, three counties, and fifty-seven districts, one prefecture and five counties submitting; in thirty-nine engagements large and small, Governor-General of Xuan and Da Lu Xiangsheng died in battle, and Prince De Zhu Yousheng, Prince Zhu Cihan, Defender-General of the State Zhu Dang, Governor-General and eunuch Feng Yunsheng, and others were captured, with more than five hundred thousand people taken captive and booty in like measure.
translations.idiomatic: On bing-yin Dorgon and Dodo reported a sweep from Beijing through Shanxi and back into Shandong: Jinan fell, the country was trampled for thousands of li, and Ming armies broke at their approach. They took one prefecture, three counties, and fifty-seven districts, with one prefecture and five counties surrendering; in thirty-nine fights Lu Xiangsheng, governor of Xuan and Da, was killed; Prince De Zhu Yousheng, Prince Zhu Cihan, Defender-General Zhu Dang, and the eunuch grand coordinator Feng Yunsheng were among those captured, with over half a million people and commensurate spoil.

sentences.zh: 是役也，揚武大將軍貝勒岳託、輔國公瑪瞻卒于軍。

translations.literal: In this campaign, Grand General Who Displays Might Beile Yueto and Duke Who Supports the State Makan died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign Grand General Who Displays Might Beile Yueto and Duke Who Supports the State Makan died on service.

sentences.zh: 上聞震悼，輟飲食三日。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard, he was deeply grieved and abstained from food and drink for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the news the Emperor mourned deeply and took no food or drink for three days.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，多爾袞、杜度又報自遷安縣出青山關，遇明兵，二十四戰皆勝。

translations.literal: On yi-hai, Dorgon and Dodo again reported that from Qian'an county they exited through Qingshanguan, encountered Ming troops, and won twenty-four engagements.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-hai Dorgon and Dodo reported again: marching out of Qian'an through Qingshanguan they met Ming forces and won twenty-four battles.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復攻松山城。

translations.literal: On ji-mao, Songshan city was again assaulted.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-mao Songshan was assaulted again.

sentences.zh: 明太監高起潛、總兵祖大壽自寧遠遣副將祖克勇、徐昌永等率兵趨錦州。

translations.literal: The Ming eunuch Gao Qiqian and commander Zu Dashou from Ningyuan dispatched vice-generals Zu Keyong, Xu Changyong, and others with troops toward Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming eunuch Gao Qiqian and the commander Zu Dashou sent from Ningyuan the vice-generals Zu Keyong and Xu Changyong with troops toward Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 阿爾薩蘭等擊敗之。

translations.literal: Arsalan and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Arsalan and others routed them.

sentences.zh: 上聞，馳赴錦州督師，斬徐昌永於陣，擒祖克勇。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard, he hurried to Jinzhou to direct the army, beheaded Xu Changyong in battle, and captured Zu Keyong.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, the Emperor rode to Jinzhou to command in person, slew Xu Changyong in the field, and took Zu Keyong.

sentences.zh: 甲申，解松山圍。

translations.literal: On jia-shen, the siege of Songshan was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jia-shen the investment of Songshan was raised.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，駐錦州。

translations.literal: On yi-you, he encamped at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yi-you he encamped at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞等師還盛京。

translations.literal: The armies of Dorgon and others returned to Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon's column returned to Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，阿濟格略連山。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, first day wu-zi: Ajige raided Lianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, wu-zi, first day: Ajige harried Lianshan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，會於錦州。

translations.literal: On ren-chen, they joined at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On ren-chen the forces united at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，渡大凌河駐蹕。

translations.literal: On gui-si, he crossed the Daling River and made camp.
translations.idiomatic: On gui-si he crossed the Daling and encamped.

sentences.zh: 己亥，杜度等師還。

translations.literal: On ji-hai, the armies of Dodo and others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On ji-hai Dodo's column marched home.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上還盛京，哭岳託而後入，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day the Emperor returned to Mukden, wept for Yuetuo before entering the palace, and suspended court for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Huang Taiji returned to Mukden, mourned Yuetuo before entering the palace, and suspended court for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以庫魯克達爾漢阿賴、馬喇希為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: On the wushen day Kuluk Darhan Alai and Malaxi were appointed Mongol banner commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Kuluk Darhan Alai and Malaxi were made Mongol banner commanders.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以索渾、薩璧翰為議政大臣。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day Sohon and Sabihan were made deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Sohon and Sabihan were appointed deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，追封多羅貝勒岳託為多羅克勤郡王。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day the late Doro Beile Yuetuo was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Keqin of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the late Doro Beile Yuetuo was posthumously raised to Prince Keqin of the First Rank.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，以貝子篇古有罪，削爵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the wuwu day, because Beizi Piangu was guilty, his rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuwu day, Beizi Piangu was found guilty and deprived of his title.

sentences.zh: 己未，鄭親王濟爾哈朗率兵略錦州、松山、杏山。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day Prince of Zheng Jirhalang led troops to raid Jinzhou, Songshan, and Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Prince of Zheng Jirhalang led a force to harry Jinzhou, Songshan, and Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蘇尼特台吉莽古斯、俄爾寨率眾來歸。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day the Sunite taiji Mangusi and Orzai led their followers in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the Sunite taiji Mangusi and Orzai brought their people over in submission.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，席特庫、沙爾虎達等敗明兵於錦州。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day Xitekui, Sharhoda, and others defeated Ming troops at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Xitekui, Sharhoda, and others routed Ming forces at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，濟爾哈朗奏入明邊，九戰皆捷。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day Jirhalang reported that after entering Ming territory he had won nine battles in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Jirhalang reported nine straight victories since crossing into Ming territory.

sentences.zh: 丙子，濟爾哈朗師還。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day Jirhalang’s army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Jirhalang’s column came home.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以鎮國公艾度禮為都統。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day Prince of the State Aiduli was appointed banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Prince of the State Aiduli was made a banner commander.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召豫親王多鐸數其罪，宥之，惟坐其征明失利，及不親送睿親王出師，降多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day Prince of Yu Dodo was summoned and his crimes enumerated; he was pardoned, but for his failures in the Ming campaign and for not seeing Prince of Rui Dorgon off on campaign he was demoted to Doro Beile.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Prince of Yu Dodo was called to account for his offenses, then forgiven; he was demoted to Doro Beile all the same, for mishandling the Ming expedition and for failing to escort Prince of Rui Dorgon when the latter took the field.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，蒙古阿蘭柴、桑噶爾寨等告岳託生前與其妻父瑣諾木謀不軌。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuzi day, the Mongols Alanjai, Sanggar, and others reported that before his death Yuetuo had plotted treason with his father-in-law Suonuomu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuzi day, the Mongols Alanjai, Sanggar, and others charged that Yuetuo, before his death, had conspired with his father-in-law Suonuomu against the throne.

sentences.zh: 代善、濟爾哈朗、多爾袞皆請窮治。

translations.literal: Daishan, Jirhalang, and Dorgon all asked that the matter be pursued to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Daishan, Jirhalang, and Dorgon all pressed for a full investigation.

sentences.zh: 上以岳託已死，不問，並貸瑣諾木勿治。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Yuetuo was already dead, made no inquiry and also pardoned Suonuomu from prosecution.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji, since Yuetuo was dead, dropped the case and extended pardon to Suonuomu as well.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣馬福塔、巴哈納冊封朝鮮國王李倧妻趙氏為朝鮮王妃，其長子𣳫為世子。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day Mafuta and Bahana were sent to invest Queen Zhao of Korea and to invest her eldest son Li Hui as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Mafuta and Bahana were dispatched to invest Queen Zhao of Korea and to confirm her eldest son Li Hui as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙申，分漢軍為四旗，以石廷柱、馬光遠、王世選、巴顏為都統，改纛色。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day the Chinese Banners were divided into four banners; Shi Tingzhu, Ma Guangyuan, Wang Shixuan, and Bayan were made banner commanders and the banner colors were changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the Chinese Banners were reorganized into four; Shi Tingzhu, Ma Guangyuan, Wang Shixuan, and Bayan were appointed their commanders and new banner colors were assigned.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，焚哈達、葉赫、烏喇、輝發前所受明敕書於篤恭殿。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day the Ming patents received earlier from Haada, Yehe, Ula, and Hoifa were burned in the Hall of Reverent Respect.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the Ming patents once granted to Haada, Yehe, Ula, and Hoifa were burned in the Hall of Reverent Respect.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以伊爾登、噶爾馬為議政大臣，星訥兼議政大臣。

translations.literal: On the renzi day Irgen and Garmar were made deliberative ministers, and Sene was also given a seat on the council.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Irgen and Garmar were appointed deliberative ministers, and Sene joined the council as well.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，遣官賚書與明帝議和，並令硃由賸等各具疏進，許其議成釋還。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the dingsi day, officials were sent bearing letters to negotiate peace with the Ming emperor and to order Zhu Yousong and the others each to submit a memorial; if peace were agreed they were to be released.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the dingsi day, envoys were sent with letters to treat for peace with the Ming emperor and to require Zhu Yousong and the other captives each to submit a memorial; agreement would win their release.

sentences.zh: 辛未，朝鮮國王李倧克熊島，執加哈禪來獻。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day King Li Zong of Korea took Bear Island, seized Gahachan, and presented him as a captive.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day King Li Zong of Korea seized Bear Island, took Gahachan prisoner, and sent him to court as a trophy.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭滿、漢、蒙古有能衝鋒陷陣先登拔城者，以馬給之。

translations.literal: On the yihai day an edict promised horses to any Manchu, Chinese, or Mongol who could break the enemy line, be first to scale a wall, or take a city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day an edict promised horses to any Manchu, Chinese, or Mongol who led the charge, was first over the wall, or took a city.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，授宗室固山貝子、鎮國公、輔國公、鎮國將軍、奉國將軍等爵有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jichou day, members of the imperial clan holding the ranks of gushan beizi, prince of the state, prince of the first rank, prince of the second rank, and prince of the third rank were enfeoffed at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jichou day, imperial clansmen of every grade from gushan beizi down through the state and lesser princely ranks received new investitures according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命貝勒豪格管戶部事，杜度管禮部事，多鐸管兵部事，薩爾糾等率兵征庫爾喀部。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day Beile Hooge was put in charge of the Board of Revenue, Dudu of the Board of Rites, and Dodo of the Board of War; Sarhu and others were ordered to campaign against the Kurka tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Hooge was assigned the Board of Revenue, Dudu the Board of Rites, and Dodo the Board of War; Sarhu and others were sent against the Kurka tribes.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，歸化城土默特諸章京以所得明歲幣來獻。

translations.literal: On the yisi day the janggin of Tumet beyond Guihuacheng presented the Ming annual tribute they had obtained.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the janggin of Tumet beyond Guihuacheng brought in the Ming annual tribute they had collected.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，以孫達理等八十三人從睿親王入關有功，各授官有差，賜號巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day yimao, because eighty-three men including Sundari had merit in following Prince of Rui Dorgon through the passes, each was granted office at a different grade and the title Baaturu.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, yimao, eighty-three men including Sundari, who had followed Prince of Rui Dorgon through the passes, were promoted in rank and granted the title Baaturu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，都統杜雷有罪，褫職。

translations.literal: On the yichou day banner commander Dulei was guilty and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day banner commander Dulei was found guilty and stripped of his post.

sentences.zh: 己巳，復封貝勒豪格為和碩肅親王。

translations.literal: On the jisi day Beile Hooge was again enfeoffed as Prince Su of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Hooge was restored as Prince Su of the First Rank.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，阿濟格、阿巴泰、杜度率兵略錦州、寧遠。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day Ajige, Abatai, and Dudu led troops to raid Jinzhou and Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Ajige, Abatai, and Dudu led a force to harry Jinzhou and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，封岳託子羅洛宏為多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day Yuetuo’s son Lolohon was enfeoffed as Doro Beile.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Yuetuo’s son Lolohon was created Doro Beile.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以宗室賴慕布、杜沙為議政大臣，英俄爾岱為都統，馬福塔為戶部承政。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day the clansmen Laimubu and Dusha were made deliberative ministers, Ercile was made banner commander, and Mafuta was made chancellor of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the clansmen Laimubu and Dusha joined the deliberative council, Ercile became a banner commander, and Mafuta was named chancellor of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，豪格、多鐸率兵復略錦州、寧遠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the bingxu day, Hooge and Dodo again led troops to raid Jinzhou and Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the bingxu day, Hooge and Dodo again took the field against Jinzhou and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，蘇尼特部墨爾根台吉騰機思等率諸貝勒、阿霸垓部額齊格諾顏等各率部眾，自喀爾喀來歸。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the Sunite Mergen Taiji Tengjisi and the Abagai Ejen Ejege Noyan, each at the head of his tribesmen, came in submission from Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the Sunite Mergen Taiji Tengjisi and the Abagai Ejen Ejege Noyan led their peoples in from Khalkha to submit.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，出獵哈達。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day the Emperor went hunting at Haada.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Huang Taiji hunted at Haada.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以劉之源為都統，喀濟海為議政大臣。

translations.literal: On the guichou day Liu Zhiyuan was made banner commander and Kajihai a deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Liu Zhiyuan was appointed banner commander and Kajihai a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅朔，豪格疏報參領阿藍泰率蒙古人來歸，遇明兵於寧遠北岡，擊敗之，斬明總兵金國鳳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day jiayin, Hooge reported that Colonel Alantai had led Mongols in submission; encountering Ming troops on the north ridge of Ningyuan, he defeated them and slew the Ming regional commander Jin Guofeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, jiayin, Hooge reported that Colonel Alantai, bringing Mongols over to the throne, had met Ming forces on the north ridge of Ningyuan, beaten them, and killed the Ming regional commander Jin Guofeng.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣索海、薩木什喀等征索倫部。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Sohai, Samusika, and others were sent to campaign against the Solon tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Sohai, Samusika, and others were dispatched against the Solon tribes.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，出獵葉赫。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day the Emperor went hunting at Yehe.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Huang Taiji hunted in Yehe country.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，上還京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiawu day, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiawu day, Huang Taiji returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，黑龍江額納布、墨音、額爾盆等，喀爾喀部土謝圖、俄木布額爾德尼等，喀爾喀、蘇尼特、烏硃穆秦、科爾沁、克西克騰、土默特諸部，遣使俱來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Enabu, Moyin, and Erpen of the Amur, Tushetu Khan and Ombu Erdeni of Khalkha, and envoys from Khalkha, Sunite, Ujimchin, Khorchin, Keshiketeng, and Tumet all came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Enabu, Moyin, and Erpen of the Amur, Tushetu Khan and Ombu Erdeni of Khalkha, and missions from Khalkha, Sunite, Ujimchin, Khorchin, Keshiketeng, and Tumet all presented tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲子，命朝鮮質子李𣳫歸省父疾，仍令遣別子及𣳫子來質。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the jiazi day, the Korean hostage Li Hui was allowed to return home to visit his ailing father, but another son of Li Hui and Li Hui’s own son were still to be sent as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month on jiazi day, the Korean hostage Li Hui was permitted to go home while his father was ill, on condition that another son and Li Hui’s own son be sent back as hostages in his place.

sentences.zh: 遣翁阿岱、多濟里等戍錦州。

translations.literal: Engada and Doroji and others were sent to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Engada, Doroji, and others were stationed at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏正月癸未朔，令各旗都統分巡所屬屯堡，察窮民，理冤獄。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month, on the first day guiwei, each banner commander was ordered to tour the settlements under his command, look into the plight of the poor, and redress wrongful imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary first month, guiwei, every banner commander was ordered to inspect the settlements in his charge, relieve the destitute, and hear grievances.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，遣多濟里以寧古塔兵三百往征兀札喇部。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the bingchen day, Doroji was sent with three hundred troops from Ningguta to campaign against the Ujala tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingchen day, Doroji was sent with three hundred men from Ningguta against the Ujala tribe.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戶部承政馬福塔卒，以車爾格代之，覺羅錫翰為工部承政。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day Chancellor of the Board of Revenue Mafuta died; Cheergol succeeded him, and Giolo Sihen became chancellor of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Chancellor Mafuta of the Board of Revenue died; Cheergol replaced him, and Giolo Sihen was named chancellor of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，朝鮮國王第三子橑來質。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day the Korean king’s third son Tiao arrived as a hostage.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the Korean king’s third son, Tiao, arrived at court as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，遣勞薩、吳拜等略廣寧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingxu day, Laosa and Wubai were sent to raid Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu day, Laosa and Wubai were sent to raid Guangning.

sentences.zh: 己丑，勞薩、吳拜以逗遛議罰有差。

translations.literal: On the jichou day Laosa and Wubai were penalized at different grades for dilatoriness.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Laosa and Wubai were punished in differing degrees for delay on campaign.

sentences.zh: 薩木什喀等征虎爾哈部，克雅克薩城。

translations.literal: Samusika and others campaigning against the Hurka tribes took the city of Yaksa.
translations.idiomatic: Samusika and the others sent against the Hurka tribes captured Yaksa.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命濟爾哈朗、多鐸築義州城，駐兵屯田，進逼山海關。

translations.literal: On the jihai day Jirhalang and Dodo were ordered to build the walls of Yizhou, station troops for garrison farming, and press closer to Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Jirhalang and Dodo were ordered to rebuild Yizhou, plant garrisons on the land, and tighten the noose on Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，戶部參政碩詹徵朝鮮水師糧米赴大凌、小凌二河。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day Board Assessor Suojan was sent to levy grain and rice from the Korean navy for the Daling and Xiaoling rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Board Assessor Suojan was dispatched to requisition grain and rice from the Korean fleet for the Daling and Xiaoling rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，索海、薩木什喀征索倫部奏捷。

translations.literal: On the yisi day Sohai and Samusika, campaigning against the Solon tribes, reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Sohai and Samusika reported victory in the Solon campaign.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子朔，罷元旦、萬壽諸王貝勒獻物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the first day renzi, the presentation of gifts by princes and beile at New Year’s Day and the imperial birthday was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the first day renzi, the custom whereby princes and beile presented gifts at New Year and on the imperial birthday was ended.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索海、薩木什喀征索倫師還，上宴勞於實勝寺。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, when the Solon expedition returned, the Emperor feasted the troops at the Temple of Sure Victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, with the Solon columns home, Huang Taiji gave them a victory feast at the Temple of Sure Victory.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上視師義州。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day the Emperor went in person to review the army at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Huang Taiji went in person to inspect the army at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，渡遼河。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the guiwei day, the Liao River was crossed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiwei day, the army crossed the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，碩詹以朝鮮水師至。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day Suojan arrived with the Korean fleet.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Suojan came in with the Korean ships.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上至義州。

translations.literal: On the guisi day the Emperor reached Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Huang Taiji arrived at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，蒙古多羅特部人蘇班代等自杏山遣人約降。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day Subandai and others of the Dorot tribe beyond Xingshan sent men to arrange surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Subandai and others of the Dorot Mongols beyond Xingshan sent envoys to negotiate surrender.

sentences.zh: 上命濟爾哈朗等率軍迎之，戒曰：「此行勿領多人，敵見我兵少，必來拒戰。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Jirhalang and others to lead troops to receive them, admonishing them: “On this march do not take too many men. When the enemy sees our force is small, they are sure to come out and fight.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji ordered Jirhalang and the others to go and bring them in, warning: “Take only a small detachment. When the Ming see how few we are, they will surely offer battle.

sentences.zh: 我分兵為三，以前隊拒戰，後二隊為援。

translations.literal: We shall divide into three bodies: the vanguard will engage while the other two act as reserves.”
translations.idiomatic: Split into three: let the van fight while the other two columns stand ready as reserves.”

sentences.zh: 」至杏山，祖大壽果遣劉周智、吳三桂列陣逼我。

translations.literal: When they reached Xingshan, Zu Dashou indeed sent Liu Zhouzhi and Wu Sangui to draw up battle lines and press the Qing troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Xingshan, Zu Dashou did send Liu Zhouzhi and Wu Sangui to form line and drive at the Qing force.

sentences.zh: 濟爾哈朗等偽卻，縱兵反擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Jirhalang and the others feigned retreat, then wheeled and counterattacked, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang and his officers feigned retreat, then turned and struck back, routing the Ming army.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命勞薩、吳拜等略海邊。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day Laosa, Wubai, and others were ordered to raid the coast.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Laosa, Wubai, and others were sent to raid along the coast.

sentences.zh: 索倫部三百三十七戶續來降。

translations.literal: Another 337 households of the Solon tribe came in submission.
translations.idiomatic: Another 337 Solon households submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上率師攻克五里臺。

translations.literal: On the renyin day the Emperor in person led the army in taking Wulitai.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Huang Taiji himself led the assault that took Wulitai.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以紅衣砲攻錦州。

translations.literal: On the yisi day red-coated cannon were used to bombard Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day red-coated cannon were turned on Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，刈其禾而還。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day the grain fields were reaped and the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the troops cut the standing grain and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，駕還京。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Huang Taiji returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，多爾袞、豪格、杜度、阿巴泰、濟爾哈朗等屯田義州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the yichou day, Dorgon, Hooge, Dudu, Abatai, Jirhalang, and others garrisoned Yizhou for farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yichou day, Dorgon, Hooge, Dudu, Abatai, Jirhalang, and others settled at Yizhou to farm the garrison fields.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，朝鮮世子李𣳫至。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day the Korean heir Li Hui arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the Korean crown prince Li Hui arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 先是，朝鮮遣總兵官林慶業等載米同我使洪尼喀等自大凌河運三山島，遇風，覆沒者半，與明兵戰又失利，乃命陵輓至蓋州、耀州，留其兵千五百人于海州。

translations.literal: Earlier Korea had sent the regional commander Lim Gyeong-yeop and others to carry grain with our envoy Hongnika and others from the Daling River to Sanshan Island; they met a storm and half were lost; fighting Ming troops they were again defeated, so the grain was hauled overland to Gaizhou and Yaozhou, and 1,500 of their troops were left at Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Korea had sent Lim Gyeong-yeop and other commanders with grain, escorted by our envoy Hongnika, from the Daling River toward Sanshan Island; a storm sank half the convoy, and a clash with Ming forces ended in another defeat, so the rice was carted overland to Gaizhou and Yaozhou while fifteen hundred Korean troops were left at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，多濟里、喀柱征兀札喇部師還。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day the columns of Doroji and Kaju, campaigning against the Ujala tribe, returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Doroji and Kaju returned from the Ujala expedition.

sentences.zh: 遣朝鮮王次子李淏歸省。

translations.literal: The Korean king’s second son Li Hao was sent home on leave.
translations.idiomatic: The Korean king’s second son, Li Hao, was allowed to return home on a visit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰朔，敘征索倫功，索海等賞賚進秩有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day gengchen, achievements in the Solon campaign were rewarded and Sohai and others were promoted and enriched at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the first day gengchen, victors of the Solon campaign were rewarded and Sohai and others were promoted and enriched according to merit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，定征索倫違律罪，薩木什喀等黜罰有差。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day penalties for breaches of discipline on the Solon expedition were fixed, and Samusika and others were demoted or fined at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the code for breaches on the Solon expedition was applied, and Samusika and others were demoted or fined in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，多爾袞等奏克錦州十一臺，請分兵為兩翼屯駐。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day Dorgon and others reported the capture of eleven redoubts at Jinzhou and asked that the army be divided into two wings for encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Dorgon reported eleven Jinzhou redoubts taken and asked leave to split the army into two encamped wings.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，明總督洪承疇以兵四萬壁杏山，遣騎挑戰，多爾袞等擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the guisi day Ming Governor Hong Chengchou with 40,000 men entrenched at Xingshan and sent cavalry to challenge; Dorgon and the others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Ming Governor Hong Chengchou entrenched forty thousand men at Xingshan and sent horsemen to provoke battle; Dorgon and his officers beat them back.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣吳拜往助多爾袞軍。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day Wubai was sent to reinforce Dorgon’s army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Wubai was dispatched to reinforce Dorgon.

sentences.zh: 丙午，席特庫、濟席哈等率師征索倫部。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day Xitekui, Jiseha, and others led troops against the Solon tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Xitekui, Jiseha, and others took the field against the Solon tribes.

sentences.zh: 上幸安山溫泉。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the hot springs at Anshan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji visited the hot springs at Anshan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，多爾袞奏敗明兵於錦州，杜度又敗之寧遠。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day Dorgon reported a defeat of Ming troops at Jinzhou, and Dudu another defeat at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Dorgon reported a victory over Ming forces at Jinzhou, and Dudu another at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，遣希福等至張家口互市。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiwei day, Hife and others were sent to Zhangjiakou for border trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiwei day, Hife and others were sent to Zhangjiakou to open the border markets.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，多爾袞奏敗明兵於錦州，又敗之大凌河。

translations.literal: On the yihai day Dorgon reported a defeat of Ming troops at Jinzhou and another defeat on the Daling River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Dorgon reported victories over Ming troops at Jinzhou and again on the Daling River.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，上還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day, Huang Taiji returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命濟爾哈朗、阿濟格、阿達禮、多鐸、羅洛宏代圍錦州、松山。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day Jirhalang, Ajige, Adai, Dodo, and Lolohon were ordered to relieve the siege of Jinzhou and Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Jirhalang, Ajige, Adai, Dodo, and Lolohon were ordered to take over the investment of Jinzhou and Songshan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，多爾袞奏敗明兵於松山。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day Dorgon reported a defeat of Ming troops at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Dorgon reported a victory over Ming forces at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，重修鳳凰城。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Fenghuangcheng was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Fenghuangcheng was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，遣英俄爾岱等往朝鮮責罪。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on the renxu day, Ercile and others were sent to Korea to demand an accounting for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the renxu day, Ercile and others were sent to Korea to call the court to account.

sentences.zh: 壬申，萬壽節，大赦。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, the imperial birthday, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Huang Taiji’s birthday, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，詔免朝鮮歲貢米十之九。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day wuyin, an edict remitted nine-tenths of Korea’s annual tribute of grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the first day wuyin, an edict cut nine-tenths from Korea’s yearly grain tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，濟爾哈朗奏敗明兵於塔山、杏山及錦州城下。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day Jirhalang reported defeats of Ming troops at Tashan, Xingshan, and below the walls of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Jirhalang reported Ming forces beaten at Tashan, Xingshan, and under the walls of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，阿敏卒於幽所。

translations.literal: On the guisi day Amin died in confinement.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Amin died in confinement.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，朝鮮國王次子李淏來質。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day the Korean king’s second son Li Hao came as a hostage.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the Korean king’s second son, Li Hao, arrived as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，命多爾袞、豪格、杜度、阿巴泰代圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, Dorgon, Hooge, Dudu, and Abatai were ordered to relieve the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, Dorgon, Hooge, Dudu, and Abatai were ordered to take over the investment of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣朝鮮國王三子李橑歸。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day the Korean king’s third son Tiao was sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the Korean king’s third son, Tiao, was sent home.

sentences.zh: 席特庫、濟席哈征索倫部，擒博穆博果爾，俘九百餘人。

translations.literal: Xitekui and Jiseha, campaigning against the Solon tribes, captured Bombogor and took more than nine hundred prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning against the Solon tribes, Xitekui and Jiseha seized Bombogor and took more than nine hundred captives.

sentences.zh: 壬申，英俄爾岱等至自朝鮮，械繫其尚書金聲黑尼等四人以歸。

translations.literal: On the renshen day Ercile and others returned from Korea, bringing in chains four Korean ministers including the secretary Jin Shengheini.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Ercile and his party returned from Korea with four ministers in chains, among them Secretary Jin Shengheini.

sentences.zh: 是歲，喀爾喀部查薩克圖遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the Khalkha Chasaktu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chasaktu of Khalkha sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚辰，朝鮮國王李倧上表謝罪。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the gengchen day, King Li Zong of Korea submitted a memorial begging pardon.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first month on gengchen day, King Li Zong of Korea submitted a memorial of abject apology.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，席特庫、濟席哈等師還。

translations.literal: On the renchen day the armies of Xitekui, Jiseha, and others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day the columns of Xitekui, Jiseha, and others came home.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，晉席特庫為三等總兵官。

translations.literal: On the guisi day Xitekui was promoted to third-rank commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Xitekui was raised to third-rank commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇四女固倫公主雅圖下嫁科爾沁卓禮克圖親王吳克善子弼爾塔噶爾額駙。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day the fourth imperial daughter, Gulun Princess Yatu, was given in marriage to Biertagaer, efu and son of Wukeshan, Prince Zhuoliketu of Horqin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the fourth imperial daughter, Gulun Princess Yatu, was married to Biertagaer, efu and son of Wukeshan, Prince Zhuoliketu of Horqin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，二等副將勞薩有罪，革碩翁科羅巴圖魯號，降一等參將。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day second-rank deputy general Laosa was guilty; his title Suon Keilor Baturu was revoked and he was demoted one grade to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day second-rank deputy general Laosa was found guilty; his title Suon Keilor Baturu was stripped and he was reduced one grade to colonel.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，以八旗佐領下人多貧乏，令戶部察明奏聞。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiwei day, because many under the Eight Banners company commanders were poor and needy, the Board of Revenue was ordered to investigate clearly and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiwei day, because many dependents of the Eight Banners company commanders were destitute, the Board of Revenue was ordered to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 諭佐領毋沉湎失職。

translations.literal: An edict instructed company commanders not to sink into drunken neglect of duty.
translations.idiomatic: Company commanders were instructed not to drink themselves into neglect of duty.

sentences.zh: 其有因飲酒失業者四十八人並解任。

translations.literal: Forty-eight who had lost their posts through drink were all removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-eight men who had lost their posts through drink were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 諭諸王大臣教子弟習射。

translations.literal: The princes and great ministers were instructed to teach their sons and younger kin archery.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers were told to train their sons and younger kin in archery.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，多爾袞等奏敗明兵。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day Dorgon and others reported defeating Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Dorgon and others reported a victory over Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，濟爾哈朗等代圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the jimao day, Jirhalang and others took over the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jimao day, Jirhalang and others relieved the investment of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，降和碩睿親王多爾袞、肅親王豪格為多羅郡王，多羅貝勒阿巴泰、杜度以下罰銀有差。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day Prince Rui of the First Rank Dorgon and Prince Su of the First Rank Hooge were demoted to princes of the second rank; Doro beile Abatai, Dudu, and those below were fined silver in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Prince Rui Dorgon and Prince Su Hooge were reduced to princes of the second rank; Abatai, Dudu, and the other beile were fined silver in differing sums.

sentences.zh: 是時，祖大壽為明守錦州，屢招之不應。

translations.literal: At this time Zu Dashou was defending Jinzhou for the Ming; repeated summonses brought no answer.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zu Dashou held Jinzhou for the Ming; summons were sent again and again, but he would not yield.

sentences.zh: 上令諸王迭出困之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the princes to take turns maintaining the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji ordered the princes to relieve one another in pressing the siege.

sentences.zh: 而多爾袞等駐營錦州三十里外，又時遣軍士還家，故有是命。

translations.literal: But Dorgon and the others had camped thirty li outside Jinzhou and often sent soldiers home, hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon and his fellows, however, had camped thirty li from Jinzhou and often let soldiers go home—hence the reprimand.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣朝鮮總兵柳琳等率兵助濟爾哈朗軍。

translations.literal: On the jihai day Korean commander-in-chief Liu Lin and others were sent with troops to reinforce Jirhalang's army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the Korean commander Liu Lin and others were sent with troops to reinforce Jirhalang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，濟爾哈朗奏克錦州外城。

translations.literal: On the renyin day Jirhalang reported the capture of Jinzhou's outer city.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Jirhalang reported that Jinzhou's outer city had been taken.

sentences.zh: 初，我軍環錦州而營，深溝高壘，絕明兵出入，城中大懼。

translations.literal: Initially our army encamped around Jinzhou with deep trenches and high ramparts, cutting off Ming movement in and out; the city was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Our army had first ringed Jinzhou with deep trenches and high walls, sealing off Ming traffic; inside the city panic spread.

sentences.zh: 蒙古貝勒諾木齊、台吉吳巴什等請降，且約獻東關為內應。

translations.literal: The Mongol beile Nomuci, taiji Wubashi, and others asked to surrender and agreed to hand over the east gate as an inside contact.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol beile Nomuci, taiji Wubashi, and others offered to surrender and promised the east gate as an inside opening.

sentences.zh: 祖大壽覺之，謀執吳巴什等。

translations.literal: Zu Dashou detected it and plotted to seize Wubashi and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou got wind of the plot and moved to seize Wubashi and his party.

sentences.zh: 於是諸蒙古大譟，與明兵搏戰。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Mongols raised a great clamor and fought hand to hand with Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongols then raised a great outcry and grappled with the Ming garrison.

sentences.zh: 我軍自外應之，遂克其外城。

translations.literal: Our army responded from outside and so took the outer city.
translations.idiomatic: Our troops answered from without and took the outer city.

sentences.zh: 大壽退保內城。

translations.literal: Dashou withdrew to hold the inner city.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou fell back to the inner citadel.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，諾木齊、吳巴什等以蒙古六千餘人來歸，至盛京。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day Nomuci, Wubashi, and others brought more than six thousand Mongols in submission to Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Nomuci, Wubashi, and others led more than six thousand Mongols in submission to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，遣阿哈尼堪等率兵詣錦州助濟爾哈朗軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingwei day, Ahanikan and others were dispatched with troops to Jinzhou to assist Jirhalang's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingwei day, Ahanikan and others were sent with troops to reinforce Jirhalang at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 濟爾哈朗奏敗明援兵於松山。

translations.literal: Jirhalang reported defeating Ming relief troops at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang reported a victory over Ming relief forces at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣孔有德、尚可喜助圍錦州。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day Kong Youde and Shang Kexi were sent to help invest Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Kong Youde and Shang Kexi were sent to tighten the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞等聞錦州蒙古降，請效力贖罪。

translations.literal: Dorgon and others, hearing that the Jinzhou Mongols had submitted, asked to serve to redeem their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that the Jinzhou Mongols had come over, Dorgon and the others asked to redeem their faults by serving at the front.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: They were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，明總督洪承疇以兵六萬援錦州，屯松山北崗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the dingchou day, Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou came with sixty thousand men to relieve Jinzhou and encamped on the north ridge of Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou day, Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou marched sixty thousand men to relieve Jinzhou and entrenched on the north ridge of Songshan.

sentences.zh: 濟爾哈朗等擊走之，斬首二千級。

translations.literal: Jirhalang and the others drove them off and beheaded two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang and his officers drove them back and took two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索倫部巴爾達齊降。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day Bardaci of the Solon tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Bardaci of the Solon submitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遣希福等閱錦州屯營濠塹。

translations.literal: On the jichou day Hife and others were sent to inspect the Jinzhou encampments and moats.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Hife and others were sent to inspect the camps and trenches at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，諭駐防歸化城都統古祿格等增築外城，建敵樓，浚深濠，以備守御。

translations.literal: On the renyin day an edict instructed the garrison commander at Guihuacheng, Guluoge, and others to extend the outer wall, build watchtowers, and deepen the moat for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Guluoge, commander of the Guihuacheng garrison, and his officers were ordered to extend the outer wall, raise watchtowers, and deepen the moat against attack.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，命多爾袞、豪格代圍錦州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the dingwei day, Dorgon and Hooge were ordered to take over the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei day, Dorgon and Hooge were ordered to relieve the investment of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，濟爾哈朗、多爾袞等合軍敗明援兵於松山。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Jirhalang, Dorgon, and others united their armies and defeated Ming relief troops at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Jirhalang and Dorgon joined forces and routed Ming relief troops at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣學士羅碩以祖澤潤書招祖大壽。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day Academician Luo Shuo was sent with a letter from Zu Zerun to summon Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Academician Luo Shuo was sent with a letter from Zu Zerun to win over Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，多爾袞等又奏敗明援兵於松山。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day Dorgon and others again reported defeating Ming relief troops at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Dorgon again reported a victory over Ming relief forces at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，賜中式舉人滿洲鄂謨克圖、蒙古杜當、漢人崔光前等朝衣各一襲，一二三等生員緞布有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuyin day, successful metropolitan degree candidates Omoktu the Manchu, Dudang the Mongol, Cui Guangqian the Han, and others were each granted a court robe; students of the first, second, and third ranks received silk and cloth in differing measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuyin day, the successful candidates Omoktu (Manchu), Dudang (Mongol), Cui Guangqian (Han), and others each received a court robe; licentiates of the first through third ranks were given silk and cloth in differing amounts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜下副都統率兵助圍錦州。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were sent with vice commandants of the banners to reinforce the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, and Shang Kexi were sent with vice commandants to reinforce the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，議圍錦州功罪，親王以下賞罰有差。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day merits and faults in the Jinzhou siege were weighed; from princes of the first rank downward rewards and punishments differed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day service at Jinzhou was reviewed; from princes of the first rank down, rewards and penalties were apportioned.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰朔，敘克錦州外城諸將功，晉鰲拜、勞薩、伊爾登等秩，復勞薩碩翁科羅巴圖魯號。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiachen, the merits of the generals who took Jinzhou's outer city were recounted; Oboi, Laosa, Ilden, and others were promoted in rank, and Laosa's title Suon Keilor Baturu was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiachen, first day: the generals who took Jinzhou's outer city were rewarded; Oboi, Laosa, Ilden, and others were promoted, and Laosa's title Suon Keilor Baturu was restored.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，我軍與明合戰，明陽和總兵楊國柱敗死。

translations.literal: On the yisi day our army engaged the Ming in battle; Ming Yanghe commander Yang Guozhu was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day our forces met the Ming in battle; the Ming Yanghe commander Yang Guozhu was beaten and killed.

sentences.zh: 祖大壽自錦州分所部為三，突圍不得出。

translations.literal: Zu Dashou divided his force at Jinzhou into three columns but could not break out.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou split his Jinzhou garrison into three columns to break out, but none could get through.

sentences.zh: 丁未，封烏硃穆秦部多爾濟濟農為和碩蘇勒親王，阿霸垓部多爾濟額齊格諾顏為卓禮克圖郡王。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day Dorgi Jinong of the Ujumuchin tribe was enfeoffed as Prince Suole of the First Rank, and Dorgi Ejiki Noyan of the Abagai tribe as Prince Zhuoliketu of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Dorgi Jinong of the Ujumuchin was created Prince Suole of the First Rank, and Dorgi Ejiki Noyan of the Abagai as Prince Zhuoliketu of the Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上以明洪承疇、巡撫邱民仰等援錦州兵號十三萬，壁松山，上親率大軍御之。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, because the Ming Hong Chengchou, Governor Qiu Minyang, and the others' Jinzhou relief army was said to number 130,000 and had entrenched at Songshan, the Emperor personally led the great army against them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, learning that Hong Chengchou, Qiu Minyang, and the Ming relief host for Jinzhou—said to number 130,000—had walled up at Songshan, Huang Taiji took the field in person.

sentences.zh: 濟爾哈朗留守。

translations.literal: Jirhalang remained on garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang stayed behind on guard.

sentences.zh: 諸王、貝勒、大臣以明兵勢眾，勸上緩行。

translations.literal: The princes, beile, and ministers, seeing how numerous the Ming troops were, urged the Emperor to advance slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The princes, beile, and ministers, daunted by Ming numbers, urged Huang Taiji to march more slowly.

sentences.zh: 上笑曰：「但恐彼聞朕至，潛師遁耳。

translations.literal: The Emperor smiled and said: "I only fear that when they hear I have come they will slip away in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji smiled and said, "I only fear that once they hear I am coming they will steal away by night.

sentences.zh: 若不去，朕破之如摧枯拉朽也。

translations.literal: If they do not flee, I shall break them as one snaps withered wood."
translations.idiomatic: If they stand their ground, I shall crush them as one snaps dry wood."

sentences.zh: 」遂疾馳而進。

translations.literal: Thereupon he pressed forward at speed.
translations.idiomatic: He then drove forward at full speed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，渡遼河。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day he crossed the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day he crossed the Liao.

sentences.zh: 洪承疇以兵犯我右翼，豪格擊敗之。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou attacked our right wing with troops; Hooge defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou struck our right wing; Hooge beat him back.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上至戚家堡，將赴高橋，召多爾袞以兵來會。

translations.literal: On the renxu day the Emperor reached Qijiabao and, about to go to Gaoqiao, summoned Dorgon to come with troops and join.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Huang Taiji reached Qijiabao and, bound for Gaoqiao, summoned Dorgon to bring his troops and unite.

sentences.zh: 多爾袞請駐蹕松、杏間。

translations.literal: Dorgon asked that the imperial presence halt between Songshan and Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon asked that the imperial camp be set between Songshan and Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 上從之，幸松山。

translations.literal: The Emperor assented and proceeded to Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji agreed and went on to Songshan.

sentences.zh: 明以一軍駐乳峰山，由乳峰至松山，列步軍七營，騎兵則環城東西北，壁壘甚堅。

translations.literal: The Ming held one corps on Rufeng Mountain; from Rufeng to Songshan they drew up seven infantry camps, while cavalry ringed the city east, west, and north—very strong entrenchments.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming kept one corps on Rufeng Mountain; from Rufeng to Songshan they lined seven infantry camps, with horse posted east, west, and north of the city—works of great strength.

sentences.zh: 我師自烏欣河南山至海，橫截大路而軍。

translations.literal: Our army from the Wuxin River's southern hills to the sea camped athwart the great road.
translations.idiomatic: Our army, from the hills south of the Wuxin River to the sea, barred the main road.

sentences.zh: 上謂諸將曰：「敵眾，食必不足，見我斷其餉道，必無固志，設伏待之，全師可覆也。

translations.literal: The Emperor told his generals: "The foe are many and their food must be short; when they see us cut their supply line they will lose heart. Lay ambushes and wait—you can overrun the whole host."
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji told his generals, "The enemy are many and must soon run short of grain; once they see their supply line cut they will lose heart. Set ambushes and wait—the whole host can be destroyed."

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，明兵來犯，擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the guihai day Ming troops came to attack and were beaten off.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Ming troops came out to fight and were driven back.

sentences.zh: 又敗之塔山，獲其積粟十二屯。

translations.literal: They were defeated again at Tashan and twelve granary depots were taken.
translations.idiomatic: They were beaten again at Tashan, and twelve storehouses of grain were seized.

sentences.zh: 甲子，明兵再犯，又卻之。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day the Ming attacked again and were repulsed once more.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the Ming attacked again and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 時承疇以餉乏，欲就食寧遠。

translations.literal: At this time Chengchou, short of provisions, wished to forage toward Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: By then Chengchou, his stores failing, meant to draw supplies from Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 上知其將遁，分路設伏，戒諸將嚴陣以待，扼其歸寧遠及奔塔山、錦州路。

translations.literal: The Emperor knew they would flee; he set ambushes on several routes and warned the generals to hold formation and cut their roads back to Ningyuan and their flight toward Tashan and Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji foresaw a breakout; he posted ambushes on every road and warned his generals to stand fast and block the paths to Ningyuan, Tashan, and Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 是夜，明吳三桂等六總兵果潛師先奔，昏黑中為我伏兵所截，大潰。

translations.literal: That night Wu Sangui and six other Ming commanders did slip away first in secret; in the dark our ambushers intercepted them and they broke in rout.
translations.idiomatic: That night Wu Sangui and six other Ming commanders did steal away first; in the dark our ambushers cut them off and they fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 惟曹變蛟、王廷臣返松山。

translations.literal: Only Cao Bianjiao and Wang Tingchen returned to Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: Only Cao Bianjiao and Wang Tingchen made it back to Songshan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，又克其四臺。

translations.literal: On the yichou day four more encampments were taken.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day four more Ming camps were overrun.

sentences.zh: 王朴、吳三桂奔杏山。

translations.literal: Wang Pu and Wu Sangui fled toward Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pu and Wu Sangui broke toward Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 曹變蛟棄乳峰山，乘夜襲上營，力戰，變蛟中創走。

translations.literal: Cao Bianjiao abandoned Rufeng Mountain and in the night raided the imperial camp; after hard fighting Bianjiao was wounded and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Bianjiao quit Rufeng Mountain and by night stormed the imperial camp; after fierce fighting he was wounded and fled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，吳三桂、王朴自杏山奔寧遠，遇我伏兵，又大敗之，三桂、朴僅以身免。

translations.literal: On the jisi day Wu Sangui and Wang Pu fled from Xingshan toward Ningyuan, met our ambush, and were routed again—Sangui and Pu escaped with their lives alone.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Wu Sangui and Wang Pu fled from Xingshan toward Ningyuan, ran into our ambush, and were shattered again; Sangui and Pu got away with their lives alone.

sentences.zh: 是役也，斬首五萬，獲馬七千，軍資器械稱是。

translations.literal: In this engagement fifty thousand heads were taken, seven thousand horses captured, and military stores and weapons in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: In that battle fifty thousand heads were counted, seven thousand horses taken, and arms and stores in like measure.

sentences.zh: 承疇收敗兵萬餘人入松山，嬰城守，不能戰。

translations.literal: Chengchou gathered more than ten thousand defeated troops into Songshan, held the walls, and could not fight.
translations.idiomatic: Chengchou gathered more than ten thousand beaten men into Songshan, shut the gates, and could fight no more.

sentences.zh: 我軍遂掘壕圍之。

translations.literal: Our army then dug trenches and invested the city.
translations.idiomatic: Our army then dug trenches and closed the ring.

sentences.zh: 是日，札魯特部桑噶爾以兵至。

translations.literal: That day Sanggar of the Jarut tribe arrived with troops.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Sanggar of the Jarut arrived with his troops.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，科爾沁卓禮克圖親王吳克善以兵至。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the yihai day, Wukeshan, Prince Zhuoliketu of Horqin, arrived with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai day, Wukeshan, Prince Zhuoliketu of Horqin, came up with his force.

sentences.zh: 命多爾袞、豪格分兵還守盛京。

translations.literal: Dorgon and Hooge were ordered to take detachments back to guard Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: Dorgon and Hooge were ordered to take detachments back to guard Mukden.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，略寧遠。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day Ningyuan was raided.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day our troops raided Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，關雎宮宸妃疾。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day the imperial consort of Guanjugong fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day the consort of Guanjugong fell ill.

sentences.zh: 上將還京，留杜度、阿巴泰等圍錦州，多鐸、阿達禮等圍松山，阿濟格等圍杏山。

translations.literal: The Emperor was about to return to the capital; he left Dudu and Abatai to invest Jinzhou, Dodo and Adali to invest Songshan, and Ajige to invest Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji prepared to return to the capital, leaving Dudu and Abatai at Jinzhou, Dodo and Adali at Songshan, and Ajige at Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，駕還。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day the imperial carriage returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the imperial train turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宸妃薨。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the imperial consort died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the consort died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Huang Taiji reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day guimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, guimao, first day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣阿拜駐錦州南乳峰山。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day Abai was stationed on Rufeng Mountain south of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Abai was posted on Rufeng Mountain south of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜等助圍錦州。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and others were sent to reinforce the siege of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, and others were sent to reinforce the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，追封宸妃為元妃，諡敏惠恭和。

translations.literal: On the jisi day the late consort was posthumously enfeoffed as Primary Consort with the posthumous title Minhui Gonghe.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the late consort was posthumously raised to Primary Consort with the temple name Minhui Gonghe.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封蘇尼特墨爾根台吉騰機思為多羅墨爾根郡王。

translations.literal: On the renshen day Tengjisi, Mergen Taiji of the Sunite, was created Prince Mergen of the Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Tengjisi, Mergen Taiji of the Sunite, was created Prince Mergen of the Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，命多爾袞、羅託、屯齊駐錦州，豪格、滿達海等駐松山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the yihai day, Dorgon, Luotuo, and Tunqi were stationed at Jinzhou; Hooge, Mandahai, and others at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yihai day, Dorgon, Luotuo, and Tunqi were posted at Jinzhou; Hooge, Mandahai, and others at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，濟爾哈朗、多爾袞奏敗洪承疇於松山。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiayin day, Jirhalang and Dorgon reported defeating Hong Chengchou at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin day, Jirhalang and Dorgon reported a victory over Hong Chengchou at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 七年春二月癸卯，上出獵葉赫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, in the second month, on the guimao day, the Emperor went hunting in Yehe country.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, second month, guimao day, Huang Taiji went hunting in Yehe country.

sentences.zh: 戊申，明德王硃由賸卒，以禮葬之。

translations.literal: On the wushen day the Ming Virtuous King Zhu Yousheng died and was buried with proper rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the Ming Virtuous King Zhu Yousheng died and was buried with full ceremony.

sentences.zh: 戊午，阿濟格奏敗明兵於寧遠。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day Ajige reported defeating Ming troops at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Ajige reported a victory over Ming forces at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，豪格、阿達禮、多鐸、羅洛宏奏拔松山，擒明總督洪承疇，巡撫邱民仰，總兵王廷臣、曹變蛟、祖大樂，游擊祖大名、大成等。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Hooge, Adali, Dodo, and Luoluo Hong reported taking Songshan and capturing Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou, governor Qiu Minyang, commanders Wang Tingchen, Cao Bianjiao, and Zu Dale, and rangers Zu Daming, Dacheng, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Hooge, Adali, Dodo, and Luoluo Hong reported Songshan taken and Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou, governor Qiu Minyang, commanders Wang Tingchen, Cao Bianjiao, and Zu Dale, and rangers Zu Daming and Dacheng among the prisoners.

sentences.zh: 先是，承疇援絕，屢突圍不得出，其副將夏承德約降，且請為內應，以子夏舒為質。

translations.literal: Earlier Chengchou's relief had been cut off; repeated attempts to break out failed. His deputy Xia Chengde arranged surrender and offered to act as inside contact, pledging his son Xia Shu as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chengchou's relief had been cut; he had tried again and again to break out without success. His deputy Xia Chengde then agreed to surrender and offered to open the gates from within, giving his son Xia Shu as pledge.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜半，豪格等梯城破之。

translations.literal: At midnight on wuwu day Hooge and the others scaled the walls and stormed the city.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on wuwu day Hooge and his officers went over the wall and stormed the town.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，上以所俘獲分賚官軍，收軍器貯松山城。

translations.literal: When victory was announced the Emperor distributed the captives and booty among the troops and stored weapons in Songshan city.
translations.idiomatic: When word of victory came, Huang Taiji divided captives and booty among the army and stored the captured arms in Songshan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上還宮。

translations.literal: On the renxu day the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Huang Taiji returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，殺邱民仰、王廷臣、曹變蛟。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guiyou day, Qiu Minyang, Wang Tingchen, and Cao Bianjiao were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day, Qiu Minyang, Wang Tingchen, and Cao Bianjiao were put to death.

sentences.zh: 諭洪承疇、祖大樂來京，而縱大名、大成入錦州。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou and Zu Dale were summoned to the capital; Zu Daming and Dacheng were released to enter Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou and Zu Dale were summoned to the capital; Zu Daming and Dacheng were sent into Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，克錦州，祖大壽以所部七千餘人出降。

translations.literal: On the jimao day Jinzhou was taken; Zu Dashou came out in surrender with more than seven thousand of his men.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Jinzhou fell; Zu Dashou came out in surrender with more than seven thousand men.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，阿濟格等奏明遣職方郎中馬紹愉來乞和，出明帝敕兵部尚書陳新甲書為驗。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day Ajige and others reported that the Ming had sent Bureau Secretary Ma Shaoyu to sue for peace, producing as proof the Ming emperor's order to Minister of War Chen Xinji.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Ajige reported that the Ming had sent Bureau Secretary Ma Shaoyu to sue for peace, offering as proof an imperial order to Minister of War Chen Xinji.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「明之筆札多不實，且詞意誇大，非有欲和之誠。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: “Ming correspondence is often untrue, and the wording is boastful; there is no sincere wish for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji said: “Ming letters are seldom truthful and their tone is grandiose—they show no real will to make peace.

sentences.zh: 然彼真偽不可知，而和好固朕夙原。

translations.literal: Yet whether they are genuine cannot be known, while peace has long been my own heartfelt wish.
translations.idiomatic: Whether they mean it I cannot tell, yet amity has been my own wish from the first.

sentences.zh: 朕為百萬生靈計，若事果成，各君其國，使民安業，則兩國俱享太平之福。

translations.literal: For the sake of a million lives, if matters truly succeed, each shall rule his own realm and the people live in peace—then both states will share the blessing of tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: For a million souls, if peace is truly made, each ruler keeps his realm and the people their livelihood, and both states enjoy long calm.

sentences.zh: 爾等以朕意傳示之。

translations.literal: You shall convey my meaning to them.
translations.idiomatic: Convey my mind to them.”

sentences.zh: 」乙未，諭多爾袞、豪格駐杏山、塔山，濟爾哈朗、阿濟格、阿達禮等還京。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day he ordered Dorgon and Hooge to garrison Xingshan and Tashan; Jirhalang, Ajige, Adai, and others to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day he ordered Dorgon and Hooge to hold Xingshan and Tashan; Jirhalang, Ajige, Adai, and the rest returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，敕諭吳三桂等降。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the dingwei day, an edict summoned Wu Sangui and others to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, dingwei: an edict called on Wu Sangui and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大小二日並出，大者旋沒。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day two suns, large and small, appeared together; the larger soon vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day two suns appeared at once, large and small; the larger soon disappeared.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，濟爾哈朗、多爾袞、豪格等奏克塔山。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day Jirhalang, Dorgon, Hooge, and others reported the capture of Tashan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jirhalang, Dorgon, Hooge, and others reported Tashan taken.

sentences.zh: 甲子，奏克杏山。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day they reported the capture of Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day they reported Xingshan taken.

sentences.zh: 毀松山、杏山、塔山三城。

translations.literal: The three towns of Songshan, Xingshan, and Tashan were demolished.
translations.idiomatic: The three strongholds of Songshan, Xingshan, and Tashan were razed.

sentences.zh: 濟爾哈朗等班師。

translations.literal: Jirhalang and the others withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhalang and his officers led the army home.

sentences.zh: 以阿巴泰守錦州。

translations.literal: Abatai was left to hold Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Abatai was left to guard Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳朔，濟爾哈朗等奏明遣馬紹愉來議和，遣使迓之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day jisi, Jirhalang reported that the Ming had sent Ma Shaoyu to negotiate peace; envoys were sent to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jisi, first day: Jirhalang reported the Ming had sent Ma Shaoyu to treat for peace; envoys went out to receive him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，洪承疇、祖大壽等至，入見請死。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day Hong Chengchou, Zu Dashou, and others arrived, entered audience, and begged for death.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Hong Chengchou, Zu Dashou, and the rest came in, had audience, and asked to die.

sentences.zh: 上赦之，諭以盡忠報效，承疇等泣謝。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned them and urged loyal service; Hong Chengchou and the others wept in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji spared them and urged loyal service; Hong Chengchou and the others wept their thanks.

sentences.zh: 上問承疇曰：「明帝視宗室被俘，置若罔聞。

translations.literal: The Emperor asked Hong Chengchou: “The Ming emperor treated captured imperial clansmen as if he had not heard.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji asked Hong Chengchou: “When imperial clansmen were taken prisoner, the Ming emperor acted as though he had not heard.

sentences.zh: 陣亡將帥及窮蹙降我者，皆孥戮之。

translations.literal: Commanders killed in battle and those who, driven to extremity, surrendered to me—all had their wives and children slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: Generals killed in the field and men who, hard pressed, surrendered to me—all had wives and children put to death.

sentences.zh: 舊規乎？

translations.literal: Was this an old rule?
translations.idiomatic: Was that an old rule?

sentences.zh: 抑新例乎？

translations.literal: Or a new practice?
translations.idiomatic: Or a new one?”

sentences.zh: 」承疇對曰：「昔無此例，近因文臣妄奏，故然。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou replied: “There was never such a rule; lately civil officials rashly memorialized, and so it came about.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou answered: “There was no such rule before; lately civil officials memorialized rashly, and so it was done.”

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「君暗臣蔽，枉殺至此。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: “A dark sovereign and obstructive ministers—wrongful killing has reached this point.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji said: “A blind sovereign and obstructive ministers—innocents have been killed to this extent.

sentences.zh: 夫將士被擒乞降，使其可贖，猶當贖之，奈何戮其妻子！

translations.literal: When officers and men are taken and beg to surrender, if they can be ransomed they should still be ransomed—how can you slaughter their wives and children!
translations.idiomatic: When soldiers are captured and beg to yield, if they can be redeemed they should be redeemed—why slaughter their families!”

sentences.zh: 」承疇曰：「皇上真仁主也。

translations.literal: Hong Chengchou said: “Your Majesty is truly a benevolent sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Chengchou said: “Your Majesty is a truly humane ruler.”

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，禁善友邪教，誅黨首李國梁等十六人。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day the Shanyou heterodox sect was banned; sect leaders including Li Guoliang, sixteen men in all, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Shanyou heterodox cult was suppressed; its chief Li Guoliang and fifteen others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬午，明使馬紹愉等始至。

translations.literal: On the renwu day the Ming envoys Ma Shaoyu and others at last arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Ming envoys led by Ma Shaoyu at last arrived.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，都察院參政祖可法、張存仁言：「明寇盜日起，兵力竭而倉廩虛，徵調不前，勢如瓦解。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the xinchou day, Censorate officials Zu Kefa and Zhang Cunren memorialized: “Ming bandits rise day by day; military strength is spent and granaries empty; levies do not advance—the situation crumbles like ice melting.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, xinchou: Zu Kefa and Zhang Cunren of the Censorate wrote: “Ming rebels grow daily; armies are spent and stores empty; levies stall—the realm is coming apart.

sentences.zh: 守遼將帥喪失八九，今不得已乞和，計必南遷。

translations.literal: Of the Liaodong garrison commanders, eight or nine in ten are lost; now they beg peace from necessity—they are sure to move the capital south.
translations.idiomatic: Eight or nine of ten Liaodong commanders are gone; forced to sue for peace, they will surely move the court south.

sentences.zh: 宜要其納貢稱臣，以黃河為界。

translations.literal: We should require tribute and acknowledgement as vassal, with the Yellow River as border.
translations.idiomatic: We should demand tribute and vassal status, with the Yellow River as the border.”

sentences.zh: 」上不納。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not accept this.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji would not hear it.

sentences.zh: 以書報明帝曰：「向屢致書修好，貴國不從，事屬既往，其又何言。

translations.literal: He wrote to the Ming emperor: “We repeatedly sent letters seeking amity; your state would not agree—that is past. What more is there to say?
translations.idiomatic: He wrote the Ming emperor: “We wrote again and again seeking peace; your court refused—that is past. What is left to say?

sentences.zh: 予承天眷，自東北海濱以訖西北，其間使犬、使鹿產狐產貂之地，暨厄魯特部、斡難河源，皆我臣服，蒙古、朝鮮盡入版圖，用是昭告天地，正位改元。

translations.literal: By Heaven’s favor I rule from the eastern sea shore to the northwest—lands where dogsled and reindeer go, where fox and sable are bred, the Eleuth tribes and the Onon headwaters—all submit; Mongolia and Korea are within my map; therefore I announced Heaven and Earth and took the throne under a new reign era.
translations.idiomatic: By Heaven’s grace I hold sway from the eastern sea to the northwest—dog-sled and reindeer country, lands of fox and sable, the Eleuths and the Onon headwaters—all bow; Mongolia and Korea are in my realm; I have therefore announced Heaven and Earth and changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 邇者兵入爾境，克城陷陣，乘勝長驅，亦復何畏。

translations.literal: Lately my armies entered your territory, stormed cities and broke battle lines, and drove victoriously—what is there to fear?
translations.idiomatic: Lately my hosts entered your borders, took cities and broke your lines, and swept on in victory—what have you to fear?

sentences.zh: 余特惓惓為百萬生靈計，若能各審禍福，誠心和好，自茲以往，盡釋宿怨，尊卑之分，又奚較焉。

translations.literal: I think only of a million lives; if each weighs fortune and ruin and seeks true peace, from this day all old grievances shall be released—why quibble over rank?
translations.idiomatic: I care only for a million lives; if both sides weigh fortune and ruin and seek true peace, from this day let old wrongs go—why haggle over precedence?

sentences.zh: 古云：『情通則明，情蔽則暗。

translations.literal: The ancients said: ‘When feelings communicate, there is clarity; when feelings are blocked, darkness.’
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said: ‘Where feeling is open there is light; where feeling is blocked there is darkness.’

sentences.zh: 』使者往來，期以面見，情不壅蔽。

translations.literal: Let envoys come and go and meet face to face, so feeling is not blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Let envoys travel and meet face to face, so feeling is not stopped.”

sentences.zh: 吉凶大事，交相慶弔。

translations.literal: On great occasions of fortune or grief, let each offer congratulations or mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On great occasions of joy or mourning, let each send congratulations or condolences.

sentences.zh: 歲各以地所產互為餽遺，兩國逃亡亦互歸之。

translations.literal: Each year exchange local products as gifts; fugitives of both states shall likewise be returned.
translations.idiomatic: Each year exchange local produce as gifts; fugitives of either state shall be returned.

sentences.zh: 以寧遠雙樹堡為貴國界，塔山為我國界，而互市於連山適中之地。

translations.literal: Let Ningyuan’s Shuangshubao be your border, Tashan ours, with trade at a middle point in Lianshan.
translations.idiomatic: Let Shuangshubao at Ningyuan be your border and Tashan ours, with trade at a midway point in Lianshan.

sentences.zh: 其自海中往來者，則以黃城島之東西為界。

translations.literal: For traffic by sea, the east and west of Huangcheng Island shall be the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: For travel by sea, east and west of Huangcheng Island shall mark the line.

sentences.zh: 越者各罪其下。

translations.literal: Those who cross shall have their subordinates punished.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever crosses shall have his subordinates punished.

sentences.zh: 貴國如用此言，兩君或親誓天地，或遣大臣蒞盟，唯命之從。

translations.literal: If your state adopts these words, our two sovereigns may swear before Heaven and Earth in person, or send great ministers to bind the covenant—we shall obey your command.
translations.idiomatic: If your court accepts these terms, our two rulers may swear before Heaven and Earth in person, or send high ministers to seal the pact—as you command.

sentences.zh: 否則後勿復使矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise send no more envoys hereafter.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise send no envoys again.”

sentences.zh: 」遂厚賚明使臣及從者，遣之。
