translations.literal: He then richly rewarded the Ming envoys and their retinue and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: He then lavished gifts on Ma Shaoyu’s party and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 後明議中變，和事竟不成。

translations.literal: Later Ming deliberations shifted mid-course and peace ultimately failed.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Ming court changed its mind mid-course and peace came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，諭諸王貝勒，凡行兵出獵，踐田禾者罪之。

translations.literal: On the guimao day princes and beile were admonished: anyone on march or hunt who tramples standing grain shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day princes and beile were warned: on campaign or hunt, whoever tramples standing grain shall be punished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，設漢軍八旗，以祖澤潤等八人為都統。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day the Eight Banners of the Chinese Army were established; Zu Zerun and seven others were made banner commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Eight Banners of the Han Army were set up; Zu Zerun and seven others were made commanders.

sentences.zh: 以貝子羅託為都察院承政，吳達海為刑部承政，郎球為禮部承政。

translations.literal: Beizi Luotuo was made chancellor of the Censorate; Wu Dahai of Punishments; Lang Qiu of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi Luotuo was made Censorate chancellor, Wu Dahai Punishments chancellor, and Lang Qiu Rites chancellor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，多羅安平貝勒杜度卒。

translations.literal: On the yisi day Doro Prince of Peaceful Tranquility Dudu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Doro Prince of Peaceful Tranquility Dudu died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，諭諸王、貝勒、大臣曰：「爾等於所屬賢否，當已詳悉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the gengwu day, he addressed princes, beile, and ministers: “You must already know well whether your subordinates are worthy or not.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengwu: he told princes, beile, and ministers: “You surely know whether your people are able or not.

sentences.zh: 知而不舉，何以示勸？

translations.literal: Knowing yet not reporting—how is encouragement to be shown?
translations.idiomatic: Knowing and not reporting—how is merit to be encouraged?

sentences.zh: 太祖時，蘇完札爾固齊費英東等見人有善，先自獎勵，然後舉之；

translations.literal: In the Taizu reign, Fiyanggū and others, seeing someone had merit, first encouraged themselves, then recommended him;
translations.idiomatic: Under the Taizu, Fiyanggū and the rest, seeing merit in a man, first took heart themselves, then recommended him;

sentences.zh: 見人不善，先自斥責，然後劾之。

translations.literal: seeing someone at fault, first reproached themselves, then impeached.
translations.idiomatic: seeing fault, first blamed themselves, then impeached.

sentences.zh: 故人無矜色，無怨言。

translations.literal: Thus men had no air of pride, no word of complaint.
translations.idiomatic: Hence men neither preened nor murmured.

sentences.zh: 今未有若斯之公直者矣。

translations.literal: Today there is none so fair and upright.
translations.idiomatic: Today none are so fair and upright.”

sentences.zh: 」王貝勒等皆謝罪。

translations.literal: The princes and beile all begged pardon.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and beile all asked forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 辛未，承攻索海以罪褫職。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day Chancellor Suohai was stripped of office for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Chancellor Suohai was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以紐黑為議政大臣。

translations.literal: On the renshen day Niuhhei was made deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Niuhhei was made a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，敘功，晉多羅睿郡王多爾袞、肅郡王豪格復為和碩親王，多羅貝勒多鐸為多羅郡王，鄭親王濟爾哈朗以下賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day merit was recounted: Doro Prince of Rui Dorgon and Prince of Su Hooge were restored as princes of the first rank; Doro Beile Dodo was raised to doro prince; Prince of Zheng Jirhalang and below were rewarded at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day rewards were graded: Doro Prince of Rui Dorgon and Prince of Su Hooge were restored as princes of the first rank; Doro Beile Dodo was raised to doro prince; Prince of Zheng Jirhalang and those below were rewarded in due measure.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣輔國公博和託代戍錦州。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day Defender of the State Bohetuo was sent to relieve the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Defender of the State Bohetuo was sent to relieve the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，議濟爾哈朗以下諸將征錦州違律罪。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day the offenses of Jirhalang and other generals in the Jinzhou campaign for breach of regulations were discussed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the breaches of Jirhalang and other Jinzhou commanders were debated.

sentences.zh: 上念其久勞，悉宥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of their long toil, pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji, remembering their long service, pardoned them all.

sentences.zh: 諭刑部慎讞獄。

translations.literal: He admonished the Board of Punishments to judge cases carefully.
translations.idiomatic: He urged the Board of Punishments to judge with care.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命多羅郡王阿達禮管禮部事。

translations.literal: On the jichou day Doro Prince Adai was ordered to manage Board of Rites affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Doro Prince Adai was put in charge of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，鑄砲於錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jihai day, cannon were cast at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jihai: cannon were cast at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鎮國將軍巴布海有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Defender of the State Babuhai was guilty and reduced to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Defender of the State Babuhai was found guilty and demoted to commoner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，論克錦州、松山、杏山、塔山諸將功，晉秩有差。

translations.literal: On the guichou day merit of the generals who took Jinzhou, Songshan, Xingshan, and Tashan was weighed; promotions varied.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the captors of Jinzhou, Songshan, Xingshan, and Tashan were graded for merit and promoted in due measure.

sentences.zh: 九月，敘外籓諸王、貝勒、大臣從征錦州功，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, outer vassal princes, beile, and ministers who joined the Jinzhou campaign were rewarded at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: outer vassal princes, beile, and ministers who had joined the Jinzhou campaign were rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣貝子羅讬等代戍錦州。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day Beizi Luotuo and others were sent to relieve the Jinzhou garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Beizi Luotuo and others were sent to relieve Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命沙爾虎達等征虎爾哈部。

translations.literal: On the renwu day Sharhoda and others were ordered against the Hūrka tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Sharhoda and others were ordered against the Hūrka tribes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，遣英俄爾岱等鞫朝鮮閣臣崔鳴吉等罪。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the guimao day, Ingoidai and others were sent to try the Korean cabinet minister Choe Myeong-gil and others.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, guimao: Ingoidai and others were sent to try the Korean minister Choe Myeong-gil and his fellows.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以阿巴泰為奉命大將軍，與圖爾格率師伐明。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day Abatai was made Grand General by Imperial Command and, with Tulku, led an army against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Abatai was made Grand General by Imperial Command and, with Tulku, marched against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 壬子，師行。

translations.literal: On the renzi day the army marched.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the host set out.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上不豫，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day the Emperor fell ill; amnesty was granted below capital crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Huang Taiji fell ill and granted amnesty short of capital crimes.

sentences.zh: 己未，令多鐸、阿達禮駐兵寧遠。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day Dodo and Adai were ordered to station troops at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Dodo and Adai were ordered to hold Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 以敕諭吳三桂降。

translations.literal: An edict was sent urging Wu Sangui to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: An edict went out summoning Wu Sangui to submit.

sentences.zh: 又命祖大壽以書招之。

translations.literal: Zu Dashou was also ordered to summon him by letter.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou was also told to win him by letter.

sentences.zh: 三桂，大壽甥也。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui was Zu Dashou’s nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui was Zu Dashou’s nephew.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命鄭親王濟爾哈朗、睿親王多爾袞、肅親王豪格、武英郡王阿濟格裁決庶政，其不能決者奏聞。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day Prince of Zheng Jirhalang, Prince of Rui Dorgon, Prince of Su Hooge, and Prince Wuying Ajige were ordered to decide routine government; what they could not decide was to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Prince of Zheng Jirhalang, Prince of Rui Dorgon, Prince of Su Hooge, and Prince Wuying Ajige were to decide routine affairs; what they could not settle was to be reported.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，多鐸奏擊敗吳三桂兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the dingchou day, Dodo reported defeating Wu Sangui’s troops.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingchou: Dodo reported a defeat of Wu Sangui’s force.

sentences.zh: 丙申，阿巴泰奏自牆子嶺入克長城，敗明兵於薊州。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day Abatai reported entering through Qiangzi Pass, taking the Great Wall, and defeating Ming troops at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Abatai reported entering by Qiangzi Pass, breaching the Great Wall, and routing Ming troops at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月甲辰，上還京。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month, on the jiachen day, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary eleventh month, jiachen: Huang Taiji returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，沙爾虎達等降虎爾哈部一千四百餘人。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day Sharhoda and others induced the submission of more than fourteen hundred of the Hūrka.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Sharhoda and others brought over more than fourteen hundred Hūrka.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣巴布泰等更戍錦州。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day Babutai and others were sent to relieve Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Babutai and others were sent to relieve Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，以宗室韓岱為兵部承政。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day the clansman Handai was made chancellor of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day clansman Handai was made War chancellor.

sentences.zh: 定圍獵誤射人馬處分例。

translations.literal: Regulations were fixed for mistaken shooting of men or horses during the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: Penalties were set for wounding men or horses by mis-shot on the hunt.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，上出獵葉赫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, the Emperor went hunting in Yehe country.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingmao: Huang Taiji went hunting in Yehe country.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣金維城率師戍錦州。

translations.literal: On the yihai day Jin Weicheng was sent with troops to garrison Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Jin Weicheng was sent with troops to garrison Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，駐蹕開庫爾。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day the imperial procession halted at Kaikuer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the court halted at Kaikuer.

sentences.zh: 上不豫，諸王貝子請罷獵，不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor was ill; princes and beizi begged that the hunt end—not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Taiji was ill; princes and beizi asked that the hunt stop—he would not.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，月暈生三珥。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day the moon’s halo bore three rays.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon’s halo showed three spikes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，日暈生三珥。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day the sun’s halo bore three rays.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the sun’s halo showed three spikes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上還京。

translations.literal: On the guisi day the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Huang Taiji returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，杜爾伯特部札薩克塞冷來朝。

translations.literal: That year Sachen of the Dorbed came to court.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sachen, jasak of the Dorbed, came to court.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丙申朔，上不豫，命和碩親王以下，副都統以上，詣堂子行禮。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, on the first day bingchen, the Emperor was ill; he ordered princes of the first rank and below and deputy commandants and above to perform rites at the tangse.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, spring, bingchen, first day: Huang Taiji was ill and ordered princes of the first rank down and deputy commandants up to worship at the tangse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，沙爾虎達等師還，論功賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day Sharhoda’s army returned; merit was rewarded at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Sharhoda’s column returned; rewards were graded by merit.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，明寧遠總兵吳三桂答祖大壽書，猶豫未決，於是復降敕諭之。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day Ming Ningyuan commander Wu Sangui replied to Zu Dashou’s letter but still hesitated; an edict was again sent urging surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Ming Ningyuan commander Wu Sangui answered Zu Dashou’s letter but still wavered; another edict urged him to submit.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣譚布等更戍錦州。

translations.literal: On the yimao day Tan Bu and others were sent to relieve Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Tan Bu and others were sent to relieve Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，多羅貝勒羅洛宏以罪削爵。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Doro Beile Luoluo Hong was stripped of rank for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Doro Beile Luoluo Hong was stripped of his title for an offense.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day yichou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yichou, first day: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，葬敏惠恭和元妃。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day the Primary Consort Minhui Gonghe was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Primary Consort Minhui Gonghe was interred.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，禁建寺廟。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the building of temples was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day an edict forbade the erection of temples.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，敕朝鮮臣民毋與明通。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the bingchen day, an edict ordered Korean officials and people not to have dealings with the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingchen day, an edict forbade Korean officials and commoners all traffic with the Ming.

sentences.zh: 丙午，地震，自西隅至東南有聲。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day there was an earthquake; a sound was heard from the southwest to the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the earth quaked, and a rumbling was heard from the southwest toward the southeast.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上不豫，赦死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day the Emperor was unwell and granted amnesty to all below the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Huang Taiji fell ill and proclaimed an amnesty for all crimes short of death.

sentences.zh: 遣阿爾津等征黑龍江虎爾哈部，葉臣等更戍錦州。

translations.literal: Arjin and others were sent to campaign against the Hurka tribes of the Amur; Yechen and others were sent to relieve the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Arjin and others were dispatched against the Hurka tribes of the Amur, while Yechen and others were sent to rotate the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，更定六部處分例。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day the disciplinary regulations of the Six Ministries were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the penalty code of the Six Ministries was revised.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，遣金維城等更戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, summer, on the guiyou day, Jin Weicheng and others were sent to relieve the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the guiyou day, Jin Weicheng and others were sent to rotate the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，多鐸請暫息軍興，輟工作，務農業，以足民用。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day Dodo asked that military operations be suspended for a time, labor projects halted, and agriculture promoted to supply the people's needs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Dodo urged a pause in campaigning, a halt to public works, and devotion to farming so that the people's livelihood might be secured.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，復封羅洛宏為多羅貝勒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen day, Lolohon was again enfeoffed as Doro Beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingchen day, Lolohon was restored as Doro Beile.

sentences.zh: 先是，圖白忒部達賴喇嘛遣使修聘問禮，留京八月，至是，遣還，並賚其來使。

translations.literal: Earlier the Dalai Lama of the Tubote tribes had sent envoys with gifts to inquire after courtesy; they had remained in the capital eight months; now they were sent back and the envoys who had come were also rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Dalai Lama of the Tubote tribes had sent envoys with courtesies and gifts; they had stayed in the capital eight months; now they were sent home, and the envoys were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 庚子，努山敗明兵界嶺口。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day Nushan defeated Ming troops at Jieling Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Nushan routed Ming forces at Jieling Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，阿巴泰奏我軍入明，克河間、順德、兗州三府、州十八、縣六十七，降州一、縣五，與明大小三十九戰，殺魯王硃衣珮及樂陵、陽信、東原、安丘、滋陽五郡王，暨宗室文武凡千餘員，俘獲人民、牲畜、金幣以數十萬計，籍數以聞。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Abatai reported that our army had entered Ming territory, taken the three prefectures of Hejian, Shunde, and Yanzhou, eighteen departments, and sixty-seven districts, with one department and five districts submitting; in thirty-nine engagements large and small with the Ming, Prince Lu Zhu Yipei and the five princes of Leiling, Yangxin, Dongyuan, Anqiu, and Ziyang, together with more than a thousand civil and military members of the imperial clan, were killed; people, livestock, gold, and coin captured numbered several hundred thousand; the inventory was submitted in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Abatai reported that his army had entered Ming territory and taken the prefectures of Hejian, Shunde, and Yanzhou, eighteen departments, and sixty-seven districts, with one department and five districts surrendering; in thirty-nine battles great and small against the Ming, Prince Lu Zhu Yipei and the princes of Leiling, Yangxin, Dongyuan, Anqiu, and Ziyang, with more than a thousand kinsmen and officers of the Zhu house, were slain; captives in people, livestock, gold, and coin ran to several hundred thousand, and a full tally was laid before the throne.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，阿爾津征虎爾哈奏捷。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day Arjin's campaign against the Hurka reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Arjin reported victory over the Hurka.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，多羅饒餘貝勒阿巴泰師還，鄭親王濟爾哈朗、睿親王多爾袞、武英郡王阿濟格郊迎之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the guiyou day, Doro Raoyu Beile Abatai's army returned; Princes of Zheng and Rui Jirhalang and Dorgon and Prince Wu Ajige met him outside the city in welcome.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guiyou day, Prince Raoyu Abatai's column came home; Princes Zheng and Rui, Jirhalang and Dorgon, and Prince Wu Ajige went out to the suburbs to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賜阿巴泰及從征將士銀緞有差。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day Abatai and the officers and soldiers who had followed on campaign were given silver and silk at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Abatai and the officers and men who had marched with him were rewarded with silver and silk according to merit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，諭諸王貝勒曰：「治生者務在節用，治國者重在土地人民。

translations.literal: On the jimao day an edict to the princes and beile said: "He who governs his livelihood must be sparing in expenditure; he who governs a state must keep land and people foremost.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Huang Taiji admonished the princes and beile: "Whoever manages a household must practice thrift; whoever governs a state must hold land and people above all else.

sentences.zh: 爾等勿專事俘獲以私其親。

translations.literal: You must not devote yourselves solely to taking captives for the private benefit of your kin.
translations.idiomatic: Do not busy yourselves only with seizing captives to enrich your own families.

sentences.zh: 其各勤農桑以敦本計。

translations.literal: Each of you is to encourage agriculture and sericulture and adhere to fundamental policy."
translations.idiomatic: Let each of you urge on farming and sericulture and keep to the root of policy."

sentences.zh: 」艾度禮代戍錦州。

translations.literal: Aiduli relieved the garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Aiduli took over the rotation at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，朝鮮國王李倧請戍錦州兵歲一更。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day King Li Zong of Korea asked that the troops garrisoning Jinzhou be rotated once a year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day King Li Zong of Korea asked that the Jinzhou garrison be relieved once a year.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，諭戶、兵二部清察蒙古人丁，編入佐領，俱令披甲。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the Boards of Revenue and War were instructed to conduct a thorough review of Mongol households, enroll them in company rolls, and order all to bear armor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the Boards of Revenue and War were ordered to muster Mongol households, enroll them under company officers, and put every man in armor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，阿爾津等師還，論功賞賚有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, autumn, on the wuxu day, Arjin and the others returned; achievements were rewarded and gifts given at different grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the wuxu day, Arjin and his column returned; rewards and gifts were apportioned by merit.

sentences.zh: 諭諸王勿以黃金飾鞍勒。

translations.literal: The princes were instructed not to adorn saddles and bridles with gold.
translations.idiomatic: The princes were forbidden to trim saddles and bridles with gold.

sentences.zh: 定諸王、貝勒、貝子、公第宅制。

translations.literal: Regulations for the mansions of princes, beile, beise, and dukes were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Standards for the residences of princes, beile, beise, and dukes were prescribed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，定諸王貝勒失誤朝會處分例。

translations.literal: On the renyin day regulations for punishments when princes and beile err in court attendance were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day penalties for princes and beile who failed in court attendance were codified.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，定外籓王、貝勒、貝子、公等與諸王、貝勒、貝子、公相見禮。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day the etiquette for meetings between outer-dependency princes, beile, beise, and dukes and the dynasty's princes, beile, beise, and dukes was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the forms of audience between outer-dependency princes, beile, beise, and dukes and the dynasty's own ranks were fixed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以征明大捷，宣諭朝鮮。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, because of the great victory over the Ming, the news was proclaimed to Korea.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day the great victory over the Ming was announced to Korea.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命滿達海掌都察院事。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day Mandahai was ordered to take charge of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Mandahai was put in charge of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，貝子羅託有罪論辟，免死，幽之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the bingyin day, Beise Luotuo was judged deserving of death for his crime; death was remitted and he was confined.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingyin day, Beise Luotuo was sentenced to death for his offense; the sentence was commuted and he was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以宗室鞏阿岱為吏部承政，郎球為禮部承政，星訥為工部承政。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day the clansman Gong'adai was made chancellor of the Board of Civil Office, Langqiu of the Board of Rites, and Sene of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the clansman Gong'adai was named chancellor of the Board of Civil Office, Langqiu of the Board of Rites, and Sene of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上御崇政殿。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day the Emperor held court at the Hall of Chongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Huang Taiji held audience in the Hall of Chongzheng.

sentences.zh: 是夕，亥時，無疾崩，年五十有二，在位十七年。

translations.literal: That night, at the hour of hai, he collapsed without prior illness and died, aged fifty-two, having ruled seventeen years.
translations.idiomatic: That night, in the hour of hai, he died suddenly without prior illness, at the age of fifty-two, in the seventeenth year of his reign.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬昭陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the renzi day, he was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renzi day, he was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，上尊諡曰應天興國弘德彰武寬溫仁聖睿孝文皇帝，廟號太宗，累上尊諡曰應天興國弘德彰武寬溫仁聖睿孝敬敏昭定隆道顯功文皇帝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, winter, on the dingmao day, the honorific title "Emperor Wen who responded to Heaven, raised the state, spread virtue, displayed martial prowess, was broad and mild, benevolent, sage, filially reverent, and cultivated in letters" was conferred; the temple name Taizong was given; later the accumulated honorific was "Emperor Wen who responded to Heaven, raised the state, spread virtue, displayed martial prowess, was broad and mild, benevolent, sage, filially reverent, respectfully diligent, brilliantly settled, greatly accomplished, manifestly meritorious, and cultivated in letters."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the dingmao day, he was given the posthumous title Emperor Wen who responded to Heaven, raised the state, spread virtue, displayed martial prowess, was broad and mild, benevolent, sage, filially reverent, and cultivated in letters, with the temple name Taizong; later the full string of honorifics added respectfully diligent, brilliantly settled, greatly accomplished, and manifestly meritorious.

sentences.zh: 論曰：太宗允文允武，內修政事，外勤討伐，用兵如神，所向有功。

translations.literal: Comment: Taizong was accomplished in both civil and military affairs; within he cultivated government, without he labored at punitive expeditions; in the use of troops he was divine, and wherever he turned there was achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: Taizong united civil and military excellence; at home he refined government, abroad he pressed punitive campaigns; in war he moved like a spirit, and wherever he turned he prevailed.

sentences.zh: 雖大勛未集，而世祖即位期年，中外即歸於統一，蓋帝之詒謀遠矣。

translations.literal: Although the great enterprise was not yet complete, within a year of the Shizu emperor's accession home and abroad returned to unity—this was because the Emperor's distant planning had laid the groundwork.
translations.idiomatic: Though the great enterprise was not yet finished when he died, within a year of the Shizu emperor's accession the realm was one again—such was the reach of his long foresight.

sentences.zh: 明政不綱，盜賊憑陵，帝固知明之可取，然不欲亟戰以剿民命，七致書於明之將帥，屈意請和。

translations.literal: Ming government was without discipline and bandits rose on all sides; the Emperor indeed knew the Ming could be taken, yet he did not wish to fight in haste and cut short the people's lives; seven times he sent letters to Ming generals, bending his dignity to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming court had lost its order and rebels swarmed on every side; Taizong knew well that the Ming could be seized, yet he would not hurry to battle and shorten the people's lives—seven times he wrote to Ming commanders, stooping to plead for peace.

sentences.zh: 明人不量強弱，自亡其國，無足論者。

translations.literal: The Ming did not measure strength and weakness, and perished their own state—this is not worth discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming misread their strength, destroyed their own state, and merit no further remark.

sentences.zh: 然帝交鄰之道，實與湯事葛、文王事昆夷無以異。

translations.literal: Yet in the Emperor's way of dealing with neighbors there was truly no difference from Tang's treatment of the Ge or King Wen's treatment of the Kunyi.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in his conduct toward neighboring peoples he was truly of a piece with Tang toward the Ge and King Wen toward the Kunyi.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，聖矣哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how sage he was!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—how sage he was!
